data.name: GameDefinitions.Builder.Guide
data.value:
Nneɛma a ɛho hia 1. Wubetumi akyerɛw nea ɛto so abiɛsa a wɔfrɛ no '%s' Steam server AppID. 2. Ngene serwer executable path a ɛwɔ serwer folder no mu. 3. Wubetumi de akwampaefo kyerɛwtohɔ a ɛto so a edi kan no. Wubetumi akenkan nea ɛto so abiɛsa yi wɔ Synix mu. 4. Paw ɔkwan a agorɔ no fa so nya n'ahyehyɛɛ fael no. Managed mode hia a complete, working configuration file - ɛnyɛ partial example. 5. Paw Validate & Preview. Siesie ɔhaw biara a woabɔ ho amanneɛ ansa na wode asie. 6. Fa, san si Synix, yɛ ahwɛde no, afei sɔ hwɛ fa/hyɛ ase/gyae/hwɛ so wɔ agodie no mu.
Nneɛma a ɛsɛ sɛ woyɛ • Asɛnka no din: nea wɔfrɛ no Synix. • Definition ID: unique lowercase ID; Synix hyehyɛɛ nea ɛto so abiɛsa no a ɛto so abiɛsa. • Steam AppID: dedicated-server AppID, ɛberɛ biara nni hɔ a nea wɔfrɛ no client game AppID. • SteamCMD app configuration: normally blank. Shared GoldSrc AppID 90 games use the verified form "90 mod folder", such as "90 mod cstrike". Synix akyerɛnkyɛm a ɛto so abiɛsa. • Executable: misali Binaries\Win64\Server.exe. Don't include the install folder. • ports: verified default game and query ports. • Maps ne game modes: kenkan akyɛde bi a ɛto so abiɛsa per line. Eyinom na wobebu nea ɛto so abiɛsa a wɔkyerɛɛ ase bere a wubetumi ayɛ nea ɛto so abiɛsa no.
Launch Arguments Wubetumi aka sɛ: Woyii nea ɛto so abiɛsa a wɔfrɛ no game's fixed flags adi sɛ normal text and insert tags only for values controlled by Synix. Ɛsɛ sɛ: -port {port} -queryport {query} -name Nneɛma{ServerName}Nneɛma -maxplayers {MaxPlayers}
Subsidised Argument Tags [LAUNCH_ARGUMENT_TAGS]
RCON RECIPE Wobegye {rcon} wɔ launch arguments no mu a nea ɛto so abiɛsa RCON commando no yɛ. Wɔ RCON syntax mu, fa: [RCON_ARGUMENT_TAGS] Nneɛma RCON syntax: +rcon.port {rcon_port} +rcon.password "{rcon_pass}"
Config Behavior • Wɔnnya nhui: Synix nyɛ nhyehyeɛ fael. • Nkwampaefo hyehyɛɛ nea ɛto so abiɛsa no akyi: fa nea ɛto so abiɛsa no mu konfig a ɛto so abiɛsa no ho. • Synix hyehyɛɛ no wɔ template bi mu: Synix frɛ no configuration a ɛto so abiɛsa. • Dwumadi no ho nsɛnkyerɛne nko ara: agodie no nhwehwɛ sɛ w'atumi ayɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow yi.
Nkwampaefo {ServerName}, {Password}, {HasPassword}, {AdminPassword}, {MaxPlayers}, {Port}, {QueryPort}, {RCONPort}, {RCONPassword}, {EnableRcon}, {Identity}, {WorldName}, {WorldSeed}, {WorldSize}, {AppPort}, {LocalIP}, {PublicIP}, {IsPvp}, {IsPve}, {GameMode} {HasPassword} kyerɛw definition's true value sɛ serwer password wɔ a ne false value sɛ the password is empty. Fa Add configuration files di dwuma bere a afedie no hia nea ɛboro fael baako. Yi source file biara, na afei yɛ ne Installed location wɔ ɔfã no so ma kwan no ne server folder no di nsɛ. Synix siesie, de, kyerɛw, siesie, na ɛyɛ nsakrae wɔ ɔfã biara a wɔatwerɛ no.
NEA ADESUAFO ANYIMFA SO FILES Fa safe path baako fa line biara ho, a ɛfa server folder a woayi no asi hɔ no ho. Fael a wohia no to ban firi mfitiaseɛ kɔsi seesei; wɔhu no a, wɔde optional files no di dwuma nanso mma wonsiw no kwan da. Bere a akwan a ɛto so abiɛsa bi wɔ hɔ a ɛto so abiɛsa no, kyerɛwee nea ɛto so abiɛsa yi wɔ Setup instructions. Synix na ɛnsɛ sɛ wokum, wokum, anaa rebɔ licensed player files. External data folder yɛ folder din a Synix bɛtumi ahwehwɛ wɔ user no Documents folders ase. Ma no nyɛ hwee bere a ɛsɛ sɛ nea ɔfa so di fael no ho dwuma no.
FƆSƐM A ƐSƐ ADESUA NO NEA ƐSƐ ADESUA NO Sɛn na wobetumi aka asɛm no bere a odiyifo bɛmfa setup kɔmaa nea ɛto so abiɛsa. Wkyerɛw ahotoso a ɛto so abiɛsa no na wohu nea obetumi ayɛ de aboa no ma wanya nea ɔpɛ. Icon URL yɛ optional na ɛsɛ sɛ wode HTTPS di dwuma. Synix san ba server executable icon a w'ayi no asi hɔ no so.
REVISIONS NE SAFETY Fi ase wɔ nkyerɛaseɛ foforɔ ne templates wɔ nsesaeɛ 1. Sɛ agodie nkyerɛkyerɛmu no sesa a, yɛ nsakrae wɔ nkyerɛaseɛ no mu. Sɛ config layout a wɔhwɛ so no sesa a, ɛno nko ara na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ no foforo. Synix ampene overwrite a ɛnni higher revision na ɔkora upgrade backups.
AFATA-INSTAL OPTION Yɛ ma Steam runtime copying no kwan sɛnea server no ayɛ nhwehwɛmu sɛ ebehia. Ɛsɛ sɛ target no yɛ relative folder a ɛwɔ saa server installation no mu. Synix twe ne nsa a wɔama ho kwan no Steam runtime DLLs nkutoo.
RUNTIME REQUIREMENT Akwankyerɛ a' edidisoɔ yi RAM ɛfirisɛ 0 Sɛ agodie no nni akatua a wɔhwɛ so. Nsɛmfua ne bere a w'ayɛ Windows ho nhyehyɛe kyerɛ sɛnea ahwehwɛdeɛ a yɛnnya mmrɛ no te ansa na yɛasiesie no, na yɛbɛma kwan ama asɛmfua a ɛnyɛ bɔne no asi; Nsɛeɛ a wɔde asɛm to ho no nsɛeɛ Windows. Paw .NET Framework anaa Visual C++ runtime nkutoo bere a agodie no ahwehwɛde a edi dwuma no kyerɛ saa. Synix hwehwɛ Windows registry mu nanso ɛnhyehyɛ anaa ntwe prerequisites no wɔ komm. Hyper-V hwehwɛ Windows Professional anaa nea ɛboro no, na sɛ wopɛ Hyper-V a, wopɛ Windows.
Launch Behavior Sɛdeɛ yɛbɛyɛ no, yɛnfa adansedie akwankyerɛ a yɛde di dwuma wɔ servers a w'ayi no asi hɔ so. Yɛn botae sɛ yɛbɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu a' ɛfa akwankyerɛ nshyesheaɛ yi ho. Hyɛ Visible Manager a ɛho hia ma games a wɔn official server manager no da adi. Eyi sesaa ɔhwɛfoɔ no ani so a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔde ahintaeɛ korabea no di dwuma wɔ saa nkyerɛase yi nko ara mu. Nkwampaefo a ɛto so abiɛsa no yɛ adwuma sɛ.exe,.bat, ne.cmd akwampaefo. Ɛfa launch-file no ɛto so asɛ sɛ odiyifo no bɛtumi adaadaa ne ho adi na ɛto so asɛdeɛ wɔ Synix mu. Wɔkyerɛ ready message no wɔ bere a w'adi nkonim wɔ agodie no ahobanbɔ soronko no mu. Saa mfiridwuma yi paw nea wɔhyɛ mu, a wɔama ho kwan Synix nneyɛɛ na wontumi mfa nkyerɛwee anaa plugins biara nni dwuma.
LOG DISCOVERY Fa safe akwan a ɛfa server folder a woayi no asi hɔ so. Fa * di dwuma ma akwan fa bi anaa fael din, na fa ** di dwuma ma folders. Asɔduro no yɛ {Identity}, {ServerName}, {WorldName}, {Port}, ne {QueryPort}. Nneɛma a ɛto so abiɛsa: logs\latest.log, Saved\Logs\*.log, profiles\{Identity}\logs\**\*.log. Synix hwehwɛɛ wɔn bere a odiyifo mpɛ sɛ ɔnya nea ɛto so abiɛsa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.OverviewHelp
data.value: Hwɛ Minecraft server a woapaw no wɔ ha. Yi no to hɔ ansa na woasesa nsɛmma nhoma, wiase, nkwakoraabɔ ne mmere, anaa bere a wɔde di dwuma. Fi ase, gyae, na san fi ase fa Synix nkwa nna ho ahobammɔ a ɛda hɔ daa no di dwuma.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.OverviewValues
MinecraftWorkspace.ScheduleHelp
data.value: Fa bere a wode bɛsan afi ase ne bere a wode bɛsiesie no di dwuma, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ woretwɛn ahwɛfo na w'adi kan ayɛ backup no nyinaa. Time de saa PC yi bere di dwuma. Ɛsɛ sɛ Synix yɛ adwuma ma ne berehyɛ no di dwuma.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ScheduleValues
MinecraftWorkspace.PlayersHelp
data.value: Kɔ so hu din wɔ intanɛt so ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔde asie. Paw anaa fa player din, na hwɛ dwumadi no so. Ahyɛde no hwehwɛ sɛ server a ɛreyɛ adwuma ne adwumam dwumadibea a ɛreyɛ adwuma. Bedrock nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa Java ban ho.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.SettingsHelp
data.value: Hwɛ server.properties ne mod/plugin configuration files. Akwan a wɔde di dwuma Synix wɔhyehyɛ bere a server.properties wɔagye nkwa. Advertised name / MOTD yɛ soronko wɔ saa entry yi din mu. Refresh re-loads external configuration edits berɛ a egyae.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.EditorHelp
data.value: Save yɛ nnwinnade a wɔsan nya. Nsakrae a wɔyɛ port, wiase, nsoromma, game mode, player limit, ne Minecraft control setup ahorow a wɔboa no nso ma Synix yɛ foforo. JSON, XML, ne YAML yɛ analysis ansa saving; nkyerɛwde afoforo hia sɛ wɔyɛ no yiye. Ma wo din ho nsɛm no nyɛ kokoam.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.WorldsHelp
data.value: Fa Java anaa Bedrock wiase ZIP kɔ folder foforo mu, na yi di dwuma. Wɔrensiesie wiase a ɛwɔ hɔ no. Wɔrentumi nsesa nhoma ahorow no mu. Switching no mmfa nsiesie, nsiesie, anaa nsiesie wiase nyinaa game/mod mu ayɔnkofa; gye wo ho to mu kan.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ModsHelp
data.value: Hwehwɛ JAR metadata ne gyinapɛn ahorow no mu, di add-on nketewa ho dwuma, anaa hwɛ server package a etwa to. Bɔ mmɔden fa game version ne loader no di dwuma pɛpɛɛpɛ. Nhwɛso ahorow a wɔde di dwuma no yɛ nyansahyɛ na ɛnkyerɛ sɛ code no wɔ ahobammɔ anaa sɛ mod biara bɛtumi ayɛ adwuma.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.BackupsHelp
data.value: Adwinnade a edi mũ no fa nkuraho nkuraho, wiase, add-on, ne configuration ho. Di kan gyae adefoɔ no di. Hu sɛ woadi nokware ansa na woasan asiesie. Asane a ɛsan siesie no gye adesoa nkrataa; asɛmdeɛ no di nhyehyɛeɛ ho adanse, na ɛnyɛ sɛ backup no wɔ ɔhaw bi a atwam mu anaa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.RecoveryHelp
data.value: Nsɛm a wɔasesa biara de nsɛm a atwam ne hash di dwuma. Paw nsakrae bi a wɔde ayɛ adwuma anaa nea wɔagyae no na ama woanya bio. Nea edi kan no, ma nsakrae foforo a ɛkyekyere ho nyɛ adwuma. Nkyerɛkyerɛmu a wɔasesa afi akyirikyiri ne wiase a wɔde di dwuma a wɔde di dwuma no wɔ ho ban. Kɔ so hwɛ backup a ɛboro so wɔ bere a wɔde di dwuma/wiase nkakrankakra ho.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.DiagnosticsHelp
data.value: Hwehwɛ nsɛnnennen a ɛtaa ba wɔ server log a ɛbaa hɔ nnansa yi ne atoyerɛnkyɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a etwa to no mu. Nea wohui no yɛ nsɛnkyerɛne, ɛnyɛ nneɛma a wɔasi so dua. Process CPU/RAM nyɛ Minecraft TPS/MSPT; fa adesoa mu nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛne no hyia no di dwuma bere a wɔnyɛ tick performance ho nhwehwɛmu.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmStop
data.value: Ɛbahola wɔava Synix wɔali gyima kɛkala ɔ?

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmRestart
data.value: So wobɛtumi asan afi dwuma wɔ Synix so seesei ara?

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.RuntimeNotice
data.value: Fa game no nkyerɛase a woapaw no, loader no, na twe fi wɔn dwumadibea ahorow no mu? Ebetumi de akɔfa Java na adi dwuma wɔ Forge/NeoForge official installer no mu. Wɔhyehyɛ server files di kan; wɔde nsɛm a wɔasiesie dedaw no di dwuma de siesie. Wɔakora wiase ne nneɛma foforo so. Yɛ backup a edi mũ ansa na woasesa game version no. Wonni agorɔ server biara.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmPlayer
data.value: Sɛde bɛma obi atumi adi dwuma? Ɔdwumadifoɔ no kwan ma wɔtumi di dwuma wɔ agyinatufoɔ no so.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmWorld
data.value: Fa wiase a wɔapaw no di dwuma wɔ mfiase a edi hɔ no mu? Wiase a ɛwɔ hɔ nnɛ no da so wɔ disk so. Paw wiase bi a ɛne saa dwumadifoɔ yi nhyehyeɛ, nkyerɛaseɛ, ne mods hyia nko ara.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.PackNotice
data.value: Wode saa adansifo a wɔde wɔn ho to wo so yi bae? Modrinth pac bɛtumi atwe file a wɔaka ho asɛm afiri HTTPS nsonsonoeɛ mu. Mods ne game scripts yɛ code wɔ game server no mu. Nhyehyɛe, hash, ɛne nhyehyeɛ, ne antivirus a ɛwɔ hɔ no nyɛ ahobammɔ ho bɔborɔ. Hwehwɛ nsakrae nyinaa mu ansa na wode adi dwuma.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.CompatibilityNotice
data.value: Nhwehwɛmu no kenkan metadata a wonni mod code. Nhwɛso ahorow a emu yɛ den, gyinabea ahorow a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran, ne metadata bi a wɔakyekyɛ/wɔahyɛ mu no hwehwɛ nsaano nhwehwɛmu. Nhwehwɛmu yi nnyɛ adanseɛ sɛ malware no nni hɔ.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Skipped
data.value: Nnansa a wɔtɔ no: {0}

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.BackupSpace
data.value: Hwehwɛ backup beaeɛ ne baabi a ɛwɔ hɔ.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmBackup
data.value: Wobesiesie adansi krataa a ɛgyina hɔ yi?

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmRestore
data.value: Wode backup a wɔapaw no bɛsan aba? Wɔbɛsesã server files a ɛwɔ hɔ no. Hwehwɛ nnwinnadewa no mu na fa nsɛm a wuhia no sie ansa na woakɔ so.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.UndoNotice
data.value: Twe saa nsakrae yi ho nsɛm a edi kan no mmra. Sɛ wɔde nsakrae yi ka fahyeɛ a, gye sɛ wɔyi no fi hɔ. Nsakrae a wɔayɛ no fa adansedi ho. Yehia backup a edi mũ de asesa wiase nsakrae biara a wɔyɛe bere a wɔhyɛɛ game foforo ase no.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.NoLogFindings
data.value: Nhyehyɛe biara nni hɔ a wonim no wɔ abakɔsɛm nhoma ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ nnansa yi mu. Eyi nyɛ ayaresa ho nhwehwɛmu a edi mũ. Fa Readyness di dwuma na hwɛ mfomso a edi kan a ɛbɛn sɛ ɛbɛtɔ.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.PreviewSummary
data.value: Nhwehwɛmu ansa na worehyehyɛ: {0} foforo • {1} a wɔasiesie no • {2} a wɔayi no afi hɔ. Wɔkora nsɛm a atwam no so de siesie. Wonni dwuma biara.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Runtime
data.value: Nkrataa a wɔde di dwuma wɔ server a ɛwɔ hɔ anaa metadata a wɔato din no nni hɔ. Sesa nkyerɛase/twerɛtohɔ nsɛm no na bɔ mmɔden bio.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Size
data.value: Saa nsɛm a ɛwɔ hɔ yi boro faenu no, metadata, anaa dodow a wɔde di dwuma no ano.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Recovery
data.value: Adesuabea mu data no nni hɔ anaasɛ enni hɔ. Kɔ so hwɛ adansedi nkrataa no na fa backup a wɔadi ho adanse.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PendingRecovery
data.value: Emu nsɛm a atwam ho adwuma hia adesoa. Siesie Asesae a wobɛyɛ no ansa na woasesa foforo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Changed
data.value: Nhyehyɛe bi a asesa fi bere a wɔhwɛɛ so anaa efi saa adwuma yi mu. Ma yɛnsan nsusuw ho bio. Wɔremmɔ nsɛm biara a ɛho ntew so.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Layout
data.value: Nhyehyɛe anaa kwan a wɔde fa nkrataa no so no nyɛ den, ɛnkyerɛ mu pefee, anaa wɔmpɛ mmoa. Paw adwumayɛfoɔ paneɛ anaa ewiase nnwumakuo a wɔaboa ho.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.ActiveWorld
data.value: Wiase yi yɛ wiase a wɔde nneɛma kɔyɛ adwuma. Fa wo ho kɔ wiase foforo mu ansa na woagyae w'adwuma.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldExists
data.value: Saa wiase folda no wɔ hɔ dedaw. Paw folda din foforo; Wiase a ɛwɔ hɔ no, import ntumi mfa nhyɛ so da.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldLayout
data.value: Fa level.dat so paw nhyehyeɛ bi a ɛwɔ wiase baako mu. Sɛ́ anka wobɛtumi de backup/reset workflow no ayɛ adwuma no, ɛservers nyinaa ne ewiase bebree archives na ɛwɔ hɔ.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldEdition
data.value: Wiase yi nni server edition no mu anaa ɛrennya ne beae/database files a wɔhwɛ kwan no. Java ne Bedrock wiase no nsesa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldName
data.value: Fa wiase fahodie fahodie din di dwuma, a wonni kwan anaa Windows din a wɔasiesie. Sɛ worefa wiase a wɔde bae no ho a, fa nkyerɛwde, akontaabu, ntenten, hyphens, anaa nsɛntiaa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.JavaOnly
data.value: Adwumayɛ yi yɛ Java adesoa modi/plugins. fa Bedrock ankasa adesuade add-on workflow no di dwuma; Java JAR ntumi ntena Bedrock so.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PackEmpty
data.value: Wɔannya nhwehwɛmu biara a ɛwɔ server no mu. Ɔdefo kyerɛwtohɔ, ɔtemmufo nkrataa, mmirika bere, wiase, ne ntini somfo amammerɛ nyɛ adwuma a modpack workflow no de di dwuma.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.LoaderMismatch
data.value: Nhoma a ɛwɔ mu no nhyia ne server software a wɔapaw no. Mods hia mod loader a ɛne no hyia; Bukkit/Paper plugins hia plugin runtime.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.CurseForgeManifest
data.value: Eyi yɛ CurseForge odwumayɛni ho amanneɛbɔ, ɛnyɛ nkuraase nkuraaseɛ. Twe ɔtwerɛfoɔ no server ZIP a ɛwɔ modification ne configurations ankasa no so; nhyiamu a enni hɔ no ntwetwe w'ano komm.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PackVersion
data.value: Nhyehyɛmu no Minecraft nkyerɛase ne loader/build no bɛgyina hɔ ama saa adwirafoɔ yi. Di kan paw na fa saa bere pɔtee no di dwuma. Wompɛ sɛ wɔde nneɛma a wɔhyehyɛ no hyɛ ananmu.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.DownloadSource
data.value: Download anaa redirect no nnyɛ public HTTPS source a agye din. Fa kyerɛwfo bi a wɔboa local server ZIP di dwuma mmom.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.DownloadHash
data.value: Dwumadie a woyii no ntena ne kɛseɛ a wɔkaa ho asɛm anaa SHA-512 hash no mu. Wɔamfa biribiara anto hɔ.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Properties
data.value: Minecraft value a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Synix mu no nyɛ adwuma anaa ɛne no nhyia. Hwɛ pon, player limit, game mode, ne control settings ansa na w'akora.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.SaveEntry
data.value: Synix antumi ansie server entry a wɔayɛ no foforɔ no. Wɔannye adwuma no anto mu; wɔhyehyɛɛ adesoa faako a ɛho hia.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.ManagementLocal
data.value: Synix's Minecraft management connection no bɛtena localhost so. Mma w'ani mmmere so wɔ Intanɛt so.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PortConflict
data.value: Port a wɔahyehyɛ no yɛ Synix adwirafoɔ foforɔ dea. Paw pon foforo ansa na w'akora.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Player
data.value: Paw dwumadi a wɔaboa ho ne player din a edi mu. Java bans nyɛ Bedrock ahyɛde.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.StartFailed
data.value: Server no amfi ase. Hwɛ Bere a Wɔasiesie ne dashboard dwumadi kyerɛwtohɔ ansa na worebɔ mmɔden bio.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.MetadataUnknown
data.value: Wɔantumi ankenkan metadata no koraa. Hwehwɛ ɔfã no ne ne kyerɛwfo nhyehyɛe ho ahiade mu.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.Duplicate
data.value: Mpɛn pii no, JAR a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri no mu biako na ɔpae mu ka saa din yi. Monhwɛ na munyi nkyerɛase a wɔayɛ no mpempem no mfi hɔ.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.ClientOnly
data.value: Saa JAR yi ka sɛ ɛyɛ adetɔfoɔ nko ara. Mfa no nto kɔmputa dwumadibea so.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.WrongLoader
data.value: Saa JAR yi metadata no nhyia loader/software a wɔayi no.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.DependencyMissing
data.value: Adwumayɛdeɛ a ɛhia a ɛnhunu wɔ metadata a wɔahwehwɛ mu: {0}. Hwɛ nhyiamu anaa gyinabea ahorow ansa na wode biribi asi hɔ.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.DependencyVersion
data.value: Dependence {0} hwehwɛ {1}; Nhwɛso a wɔahwehwɛ no yɛ {2}.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.DependencyReview
data.value: Manually check dependency {0}: required {1}, scanned {2}. Saa hyeɛ/nsɛn yi nte ase yie.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Java
data.value: Nhyehyɛe no kyerɛ sɛ Java / adesuakuw-nkyerɛkyerɛmu nhyia. Fa Java nkyerɛase a ɔsomfoɔ ne mod loader a wɔapaw no hwehwɛ no di dwuma.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Memory
data.value: Nhoma no kyerɛ sɛ Java ntumi mfa nkaebea a ɛdɔɔso mma. Hwehwɛ RAM a ɛwɔ hɔ, ɛserɛ no hyeɛ, ne sɛ ɛserɛ afoforo de di dwuma anaa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Dependency
data.value: Nhoma no ka gyinapɛn ahorow a wɔde di dwuma ho asɛm. Hwehwɛ loader mfomso a edi kan no mu, na afei hwehwɛ mod, dependence, game version, ne loader build pɛpɛɛpɛ.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Port
data.value: Nhoma no kyerɛ sɛ wɔde pon bi adi dwuma dedaw. Hwehwɛ akwankyerɛ afoforo ne server yi gyinabea ahorow a wɔahyehyɛ; mmfa firewall port a ɛnka ho mmma.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Eula
data.value: Nhoma no hwehwɛ sɛ wogye Minecraft EULA tom. Kenkan na gye tom wɔ adwuma a edi kan a wobɛyɛ no mu, sɛ wugye tom a.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Tick
data.value: Nhyehyɛe no ka sɛ nneɛma nkɔ yiye anaa obi a ɔhwɛ ne ho so ato hɔ bere tiaa bi. Hwehwɛ CPU load, wiase awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ, entities, ne mods. RAM nko ara ntumi nyi eyi mfi hɔ.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Mixin
data.value: Adwumayɛfoɔ mfomso taa fa mod/loader nhyehyeɛ a ɛnsɛ nhyehyeɛ. Hwehwɛ asɛm a edi kan no mu wɔ atoyerɛnkyɛm ho amanneɛbɔ no mu ne nkrataa a wohia no mu.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.World
data.value: Nhyehyɛe no ka wiase data a wɔkenkan no ho mfomso ahorow. Ma dwumadibea no nnyaw na fa nsɛm a ɛwɔ hɔ no sie ansa na woasɔ backup a ɛne no hyia ahwɛ.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.RuntimeRecovery
data.value: Saa nhyehyeɛ dedaw yi nni dwuma a wɔde di dwuma ho kyerɛwtohɔ. Fa server backup no di dwuma de nya; Synix ntumi nhu ne kan loader ne ne kan version.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.RuntimeMismatch
data.value: Nnansa a wɔde di dwuma no nhyia nkyerɛase, nkyerɛase, loader, anaa Java ahwehwɛde a wɔapaw no. Bue Minecraft Control Center na fa Apply Runtime di dwuma ansa na woadi kan.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.IncludeOptional
data.value: Fa server modification a wɔpaw no ka ho

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.WorldFilter
data.value: Wiase ZIP (*.zip)|*.zip

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.PackFilter
data.value: Minecraft server pack (*.zip;*.mrpack)|*.zip;*.mrpack

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.InvalidValue
data.value: Deɛ ɛfa {0} ho no nyɛ adwuma. Siesie nsakrae yi ansa na woakora.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Empty
data.value: Biribiara nni hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛkyerɛ. Sɛ wode nsɛm a ɛwɔ ha ka ho anaa wosesa saa nkomafoɔ no dwumadi a, twe ho.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.State.Superseded
data.value: Wɔasiesie no ama backup restore

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.CompatibilitySummary
data.value: {0} add-ons a wohuu • {1} nsuaeɛ a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛsusu ho. Nhwɛso yi nsesa nnwom.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.NoCompatibilityAddOns
data.value: Wɔanhunu add-ons biara wɔ mod anaa plugins adaka a ɛwɔ hɔ no mu wɔ saa server setup yi ho.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.NoCompatibilityFindings
data.value: Wɔannya ɔhaw biara wɔ metadata a ɛwɔ hɔ no mu. Eyi nkyerɛ sɛ mod anaa plugin biara bɛbom ayɛ adwuma.

data.name: AsaPackages.Button.Read
data.value: Kenkan Mod Nhyehyɛe

data.name: AsaPackages.Title
data.value: Kenkan ASA modification package no

data.name: AsaPackages.Help
data.value: Paw ASA Windows-server ZIP a woyii no ato hɔ anaa folder a woyii no. Synix hwehwɛ mod descriptors wɔ flat, wrapped, anaa multi-mod nkrataa mu na ɛsiesie wɔn CurseForge ID no ma nhwehwɛmu. data.name: AsePackages.Help
data.value: Paw ARK: Survival Evolved mod ZIP anaa folda bi a .mod descriptor ne ne ɛne no hyia Cooked mod folder no. Synix kenkan Workshop ID firi descriptor no mu, na ɛnyɛ ZIP din. Nkyerɛkyerɛmu ntwerɛmu anaa nhyehyɛe biara nni hɔ: wɔn a wɔhwɛ ase no, Synix de ActiveMods ne ModIDS di dwuma ma ARK's automatic download route. Map ne total conversions betumi ahwehwɛ server soronko a wɔde asi hɔ. ASA CurseForge nkrataa no nnyina hɔ.

data.name: AsePackages.Error.Layout
data.value: Eyi nyɛ ASE mod nyinaa a wɔagye atom. Fa .mod descriptor ne mod folder a ɛne mod.info ne cooked assets hyia no ka ho. Nkyerɛkyerɛmu a wɔde ato mu no ɛsɛ sɛ ɛne nnwᴐnkyerɛmu kyerɛkyerɛfo faenu din biara hyia. Raw Workshop .z downloads a wonni .mod file a wɔasiesie no nni ho dwuma wɔ saa akenkanfo yi mu; fa Mod IDs di dwuma mmom.

data.name: Content.046758F1CA21BD9F666A
data.value:
Fa saa akwankyerɛ yi di dwuma na w'abɔ wo somfo a odi kan. Synix de di dwuma wɔ kɔmputa yi so, enti ma PC no nyɛ adwuma bere a nkurɔfo redi agorɔ no. Ɛho nhia sɛ wobɛtwerɛ ahyɛdeɛ a wode bɛhyɛ aseɛ de asiesie biribi.
1. Bue Synix na ma SteamCMD gyinapɛn ho nhwehwɛmu awie. 2. Paw Add Server, na afei yɛ server foforo. Sɛ server files no wɔ hɔ dedaw a, paw Import Existing Server mmom. 3. Wɔ Ɔman no so, fa baabi soronko a server din wɔ na paw game no. Paw nhoma no, game no nkyerɛase, anaa loader, sɛ saa nneɛma yi da adi a. 4. Kɔ so kura nea wɔreka ho asɛm no gye sɛ wohia biribi foforo. Hwɛ nhyehyɛe nkitahodie nkrataa a wɔde ma no mu na yi nkrataa a ɛho hia ankasa a ɛwɔ ase hɔ no adi. 5. Paw Save Server. Eyi de asɛm bi ka dashboard no ho; ɛnkyerɛ sɛ agodie no asiesie awie. 6. Paw saa krataa no na paw Start. Ma download no ne ntetee a edi kan a wobesiesie awie, di akwankyerɛ biara a Synix kyerɛ no akyi. 7. Kɔ so yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ biara a ɛwɔ agodie no mu, te sɛ apam, adwenkyerɛmu, anaa nhyiamu a wobɛtumi de adi dwuma wɔ agodie no mu. 8. Fi kɔmputa yi anaa afiri foforo a ɛwɔ wo fie intanɛt so mu na kɔ. Sɛ ɛba saa a, di backup kan ansa na wode modif anaa woyɛ nsakrae akɛse.
SƐ WOYƐ NÁ WƆKƆ Hyɛ Bere a Wɔasiesie ama ɔsomfoɔ a wɔapaw no no na kenkan Adwuma & Nyansapɛ. Di mfomso no akyi sen sɛ wobɛto Start so mpɛn pii. Deɛ ɛfa Minecraft anaa Satisfactory ho no, Game Guides category no kyerɛ akwan foforɔ no ase.
Nnipa a wonni w'akoka no ho a wɔtena hɔ no yɛ ɔkwan soronko bi a wɔfa so de wɔn ho hyɛ nkitahodi mu. Nea edi kan no, gye tom sɛ server no yɛ adwuma wɔ baabi.

data.name: Content.04A9AB215D19FA573345
data.value:
Adwumakuo biara a ɛwɔ dashboard mu no hia ne din ankasa ne faahyehyɛde nkrataa. Synix sesa server din kɔ Windows-bammɔ identity ma folda a wɔaboa no ne start setup. Eyi ma wɔtwe nsɛm ho fi adansedi mu a wonnim ho; ɛnnyɛ kɔmputa afiri anaa ahobammɔ hyeɛ.
ASƐM A ƐDA SO • C:\Synix ?? main Synix data adwumayɛbea. • C:\Synix\SteamCMD ?? game downloader. • C:\Synix\Games\<game>\<server> ?? normal server installations. • C:\Synix\BackupGames ?? normal backup root. • C:\Synix\SynixData\logs ?? application logs ne crash reports.
Ɔmanfoɔ Asetenam Asɛdeɛ MSI application files wɔ %LocalAppData%\ asePrograms\Synix. Nhyehyeeɛ a ɛho hia paa ne Windows-deɛ wɔabɔ ho ban no nso yɛ wo dea Windows akonta.
ASƐM A ƐDA SO Fa Install & Launch di dwuma bere a worepaw server folder no. Deɛ wopɛ sɛ wohyehyɛ foforo no, paw adaka hunu a wubetumi akyerɛw a ɛwɔ baabi a ɛfata ma agodie ne nsɛm foforo. Mfa nhyiamufua mmienu ntena krataafa korɔ mu.
Open Server Folder kyerɛ server a wɔapaw no no tenabea ankasa. Open Backup Folder kyerɛ ne backup beaeɛ; mmfa kwan biara mmma ne din a ɛda adi no so.
Agyenkwa bɛtumi atena baabiara Agodie bi betumi de ewiase asie AppData, Documents, drive foforo, anaa n'ankasa dwumadi nhyehyɛe mu. Hu beae a wɔde agyinatu no si ankasa ansa na woakɔyɛ backup anaa woasesa.
Nkyerɛkyerɛmu anaa nhyehyɛe nkrataa wɔ File Explorer mu mma kwan biara a wɔde asi hɔ no ntena so. Di dwuma wɔ Synix adwuma a wɔde di dwuma a wɔde kɔfa/de kɔ adwuma no mu na hwɛ akwan ansa na w'akɔyɛ adwuma foforo. Nhwɛso ahorow a ɛyɛ soronko nso hia network ports a ɛnsɔre.

data.name: Content.0AD494C5598090AE9CCD
data.value: Space Engineers fa ne Dedicated Server Manager no di dwuma, a ɛsɛ sɛ Synix ma ɛhunu. Bere a ɛdi kan a ɛbueɛ no, paw Local/Console, paw Continue to server configuration, fa server ne ewiase asetena, na paw Save & start. Fa Manager no di dwuma ma asetena, ewiem, mods, administrators, ne ne console no. Synix de saa instance yi sie server no Instance folder no ase. Nea edi kan Local/Console mode no nhwehwɛ administrator rights; Windows dwumadie a wobesiesie no yɛ. .NET Framework 4.8 anaa foforɔ, Visual C++ Redistributable 2013 ne 2017, anyɛ yie koraa no 6 GB a ɛwɔ nhyehyɛe RAM mu, ne UDP port 27016 a wɔde fa Windows Firewall so di dwuma na wɔde di dwuma wɔ Intanɛt so mpanin ho. Nkyerɛkyerɛmu wɔ Twi mu: https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/dedicated-servers/

data.name: Content.0B2D550B207DD25F9B2D
data.value:
Ɔhwɛfoɔ no hwɛ ɔsomfoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔagye atom no so na ɔtumi ma wɔhyɛ aseɛ adesoa a wɔasiesie no so bere a wɔanhwɛ kwan sɛ wɔbɛfiri hɔ anaa wɔrehu ɔhaw bi.
ASƐM A ƐDA SO Fa Synix's Stop and Restart controls di dwuma de yɛ nsakrae a wopɛ sɛ woyɛ. Synix de saa nnwuma no di dwuma wɔ ɔfã a ɛhwɛ so no mu sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔremmfa adwuma a wɔrehwehwɛ no nyɛ sɛ asiane.
Sɛ wokum agudeɛ bi mfɛnsere, sɛ wokum no wɔ Asɛyɛde Dwumadifoɔ no mu, anaa sɛ wode kɔto ɔhwɛfo foforo so a ebetumi ayɛ sɛ nea wonhwɛ kwan na ɛde adesoa ba.
ASƐM A Wɔsan Fi Ase Ma dwumadibea no nkɔ Synix mu, na hwɛ game log a etwa to no. Siesie adwuma berɛ, nhyehyeɛ, pon, nkae, anaa mod asɛm a ɛwɔ ase no ansa na woahyɛ aseɛ bio. Adesoa ntumi nsiesie mod a ɛne no nhyia anaa agyinatude a enni awieɛ a wɔde hyɛ agyinatude mu.
Nhyehyɛe a enni hɔ ne ɛho nsɛmbisa no yɛ nsɛnnennen. Bere a wobegye wo ho adi no gyina agodie no ne tebea a seesei wowɔ so, enti mfa bere pɔtee bi a wɔsusu sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde si hɔ ansa na woatumi ayɛ nhwehwɛmu.
ASƐM A ƐDA SO Synix tracks supported launchers ne mmɔfra nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛyɛ server no dea. Nnwumakuo a wɔhwɛ wɔn so wɔ amansan mu anaa dwumadi ahodoɔ a wɔde di dwuma no betumi adi agyinatufoɔ no akyi na ɛhia sɛ wɔtumi di dwuma wɔ agyinatuo mu.
WATCHDOG no nyɛ backup a wɔadi ho adanse anaa sɛ wɔhwɛ sɛ server foforo bi adi dwuma bere a edi kan a ɛfi ase yie.

data.name: Content.0D2E92094CEB8EC48551
data.value:
Wubetumi de Synix's lifecycle buttons ayɛ adwuma. Ɛsɛ sɛ watchdog no de nhyɛso a ɛho hia a ɛto so abiɛsa no adi wɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne ho.
NKURƆFO Wubetumi aka asɛm no na wobehu nea ɛto so abien. Synix kɔhwɛ adwempaefo, paths, ports, ne sɛlted pre-start maintenance, wɔasra fayil bi a ɛto so abiɛsa, na wɔasra serwer. Wobekum nea ɛto so abiɛsa a ɛto so abiɛsa.
STOP Paw Gyae na ma agodie no bere ntena hɔ na to. Synix fa ɔkwampa bi a w'atumi de adi dwuma, na sɛ ɛho behia a, wɔsan de di dwuma bio. Nhyehyɛe a wɔhyɛ sɛ wɔtwa mu no betumi asɛe nkɔanim a wɔnkora so.
Nkurɔfo Yi Restart fa gyae adwuma kuo a ɛrekɔ so seesei no na hyɛ ase foforo. Mfa wo nsa nhyɛ kratawa foforo ase bere a eyi rekɔ so no.
Sɛ Button Nni So A Ɔkwan bi a ɛto so abiɛsa bi masɛi serwer no, ɛno masɛi entrance a ɛto so abiɛsa bi masɛi transient state, anaa nea ɛto so abiɛsa bi masɛi external deployment. Wubetumi akenkan nea ɛto so abiɛsa no ho asɛm ne nea ɛto so abiɛsa no ho asɛm.
Wobegye nea ɛto so abiɛsa no adi wɔ Task Manager mu anaa wobegye nea ɛto so abiɛsa no adi wɔ nea ɛto so abiɛsa mu. Ɛno bɛtumi ayɛ nea ɛto so abiɛsa na ɛbɛma woahu sɛ wubetumi asuasua no.
Agorɔ a wɔde di dwuma wɔ abɛɛfo mfiri so anaa abɛɛfo dwumadie so no hia wɔn ankasa lifecycle checks. Mfiridwumayɛni a wɔretoto nneɛma mu no, ɛnkyerɛ sɛ saa dwumadi ahorow no agyae.

data.name: Content.14E361A374F9F14F65DD
data.value:
Satisfactory hwehwɛ sɛ wɔhyehyɛ no kan wɔ ne ankasa game mu Server Manager mu. Synix betumi atoto na adi dwuma wɔ adansedifoɔ a wɔde ama no ho, nanso ɛnsesa adansedifoɔ a wɔgye di anaa wɔn dwumadie a wɔyɛ no.
Ma W'ani Nnye Bɔhyɛ No Ho 1. Bɔ Satisfactory entry no na bɔ ne ho ban wɔ Synix mu. 2. Twɛn ma adansifo a wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ adwuma no awie. 3. Bue Satisfactory's in-game Server Manager na de server no ka ho anaa paw. 4. Bɔ ho dawuru, fa w'asɛmpa no to hɔ, na kɔyɛ administrator. 5. Bɔ anaa fa dwumadi a wopɛ sɛ wode di dwuma no hyɛ mu.
Synix di dwuma de di dwuma wɔ ɛbɔ/sɛmpanyɛ a ɛboɔboa mu, a ɛbɔ no gyinabea ne MaxPlayers ka ho. Nkyerɛkyerɛmu ahodoɔ a edidi soɔ yi wɔ FactoryGame\Saved\Config\WindowsServer.
CONNECT SYNIX 1. Ma server no nnyɛ adwuma wɔ -NewConsole. Check imported or older entries mu; sɛ wode saa nhyehyeɛ yi ka ho a, to Synix so bio. 2. Fa Windows tumi krataa gyinapɛn koro no ara di dwuma ma Synix ne dwumadifoɔ no, ɛbɛyɛ papa sɛ wɔde user tumi krataa gyinapɛn. 3. Paw server no na bue Server Options → Satisfactory Control Center → Connect API. 4. Paw Connect automatic prɛko na twɛn.
Synix de server.GenerateAPIToken di dwuma, kenkan nkontaa foforo no nyinaa, di API a ɛwɔ hɔ no ho adanseɛ, na ɛkora wo Windows twerɛtohɔ no so. Token no ma administrator tumi di dwuma, na ɛnyɛ nhwehwɛmu nko.
Nkonimdi ho amanneɛbɔ Token a wɔadi ho adanse na wɔakora so yie na ɛbue Overview. Ɛho nhia sɛ wobɛtumi akyerɛw console line anaa wode wo nsa aka token no bi.
Sɛ mmɔdenbɔ no to a, Synix di nkitaho biara a wɔakora so dedaw no so na ɛnnyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ no bio. Kenkan nea efi mu ba ansa na woasɔ ahwɛ bio.
Eyi de kɔ server a wɔayi no so wɔ PC yi so; ɛnnhia router mmara foforɔ biara wɔ Synix ho. Normal Start, Stop, ne Restart da so ara yɛ adwuma a wonni API agyiraehyɛde.

Paw dashboard entry na bue Server Options. Nnwinnade a ɛboa saa nhyehyɛe no ne ne tebea a ɛwɔ hɔ seesei nkutoo na wɔde ma.
ASƐM A ƐDA SO NE ASƐM A ƐDA SO • Open Server Folder ne Open Backup Folder buee mmeae a ɛwɔ hɔ. • Nhyehyɛmu kyerɛwfo no buee agodie nhyehyɛmu nkrataa a wɔde di dwuma. • Update Server twe agokansie update a wɔboa no. • Ma Game Files nhwehwɛmu anaa mpɛsɛm a ɔhyehyɛfo no di ho dwuma no nyɛ adwuma. • Backup and Restore yɛ adwuma de hwɛ anaa nya afiri a wɔapaw no no so mfaso. • Create Batch File kɔfa twintin nsaano nkyerɛwee kɔ baabi a profile no boa no. • Delete yi asɛm bi fi hɔ na ɛsan de nsɛm a ɛwɔ ne nhyehyɛe mu no nkutoo na ɛkyerɛ.
ASƐM A ƐDA SO NE ASƐM A ƐDA SO Ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ nkitahodi ho nsɛm no da address, port, ne copy actions adi. Nkontaabuo nsɔhwɛ, Mod & Plugin Manager, Minecraft nnwinnade, ne Satisfactory Control Center pue baabi a wɔboa no.
HWƐ Ɔsomfo a Ɔretwa Nsa Hwɛ n'ahyehyɛde no so ntempem abien na woahu nkataho a ɛfa asisifo no ho. Live Process Details da nnoɔma a wɔde di dwuma, console hosts, ne adwumayɛfoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ saa entry no mu adi. Adwumakuo ahodoɔ pii a wɔdi dwuma wɔ agumadi mu betumi anya dwumadie ahodoɔ bebree a ɛwɔ agumadi mu.
Fa nnwinnade monitor no yɛ adwuma de hwɛ saa adwumakuo no CPU ne nkae abakɔsɛm. Saa akenkan yi yɛ soronko wɔ dashboard no nyinaa-PC mfatoho no ho.
Nkrataabu anaa agyinatufo ho nhwehwɛmu hwɛɛfo mfɛnsere no to ban a, ɛrensi agorɔ no kwan. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ woyɛ saa a, fa dashboard no so gyina.

data.name: Content.18D0D93C3EB881DA2D03
data.value:
Paw Minecraft edition ansa na woayi mods anaa connection settings. Java and Bedrock are separate server types; Bedrock is not a Java loader.
SET UP THE SERVER 1. Wobenya Minecraft na wobenya Java anaa Bedrock. 2. Na Java, họrọ Minecraft version, loader, ne compatible loader version a ɛto so abiɛsa. 3. Wobesusuw asase no ho, native game mode, player limit, memory, ports, ne enabled security fields. 4. Save ne Start wɔ Synix. 5. Wubetumi akenkan nea ɛto so abiɛsa anaa nea ɛto so abiɛsa a ɛto so abiɛsa no ansa na woayi no. 6. Wobegye bere a asase no bɛda so, na wobegye nea ɛto so abiɛsa a ɛto so abiɛsa. 7. Yɛ adwuma wiase no ho backup ansa na wode mods aka ho.
Java ne Bedrock Java hwehwɛɛ Vanilla, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Paper, ne Purpur wɔ hɔ a wobedi. Wubetumi akenkan nea ɛto so abiɛsa no. Paper ne Purpur fa plugins, na Fabric, Forge, ne NeoForge fa wɔn matching mods. Synix de n'asɛmti a wɔhyew no kyekyere no wɔ n'asɛmti a wɔhyew no mu.
Bedrock de official Bedrock Dedicated Server package na ɛnyɛ Java.
Ɛfa Mods Yi loader a wo mods hia no. Hwehwɛ Minecraft version, loader, dependencies, ne client-side ahwehwɛde biara.
Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, ne plugin-server pakiti no yɛ asɛkyee. Sɛ woyɛ mods anaa plugins folder a, ɛmfa ho sɛ wobekum loader anaa server framework. Browse Catalog a ɛto so abiɛsa no yɛ modpack anaa dependency installation.
Nsɛmti: Configure hwɛ server.properties ne edition-specific parameters so. Java nso wɔ Spectator mode. Technical values and controls retain the form expected by Minecraft.
Sɛ w'ahwehwɛ yɛn korabea a, bue control center Minecraft no. N'ahyehyɛɛ kratafa no kyerɛ nea wobɛtumi asesa no. Sesa fael no ma text editing; Structured Editor no de format editor a ɛwɔ hɔ no ma. Emu mmienu nyinaa kora nsakraeɛ no so bere a wɔagyae adwumayɛbea no. server.properties nnoɔma te sɛ ports, player boundary, world, seed, mode ne control channel parameters nso twe Synix input no so. Din/DMOT a w'abɔ no dawuro no yɛ soronko firi din a wɔde refa ɔman no mu. Adansedie a wɔnnim no wɔ wɔn ankasa nkrataafa mu.
Synix san kenkan saa nhyehyɛeɛ yi ansa na w'asesa twerɛtohɔ no anaa w'ahyehyɛ ase, ne bere a w'asan de Refresh adi dwuma bere a w'agyae. Sɛ external edit no nyɛ adwuma anaa ɛne ɔfã foforo no bɔ abira a, siesie ɔhaw no mmom sen sɛ wobɛsan abɔ server no bio. Ɔhwɛfoɔ no ampene so sɛ ɔbɛtwerɛ file a wɔasesa no afiri berɛ a wɔbueeɛ no; bue no bio na fa nneɛma foforo no hyɛ mu.
Nkwampaefo Ma w'afidie no nyinaa ho backup ansa na woasesa version anaa loaders. Paw runtime foforo no wɔ Setup mu, kora nea woasesa no so, na afei yi Apply Runtime in Minecraft Control Center. Synix siesie official runtime no, sie server.properties ne world folders no, na twerɛ runtime files a wɔasesa no. Ɛnkeka ne ho sɛ server no bɛhyɛ aseɛ. Mfiase no, wɔ siw kwan bere a asɛm a w'akyerɛw no ne profile a w'ayi no nhyia.
File rollback botum a ɛto so abiɛsa no, ɛno ne sɛ, wobegye nea ɛto so abiɛsa no adi, na wobegye nea ɛto so abiɛsa no adi. Womma woahu sɛ asase bi a wɔde Minecraft a ɛberɛ a ɛto so abiɛsa anaa mods a ɛto so abiɛsa reyɛ no, ɛho hia sɛ wobekum nea ɛto so abiɛsa; retrieve the matching full backup instead.
Wobekum fayil a ɛbɛboa wo ma woayi no so. Womma woankɔ so anwummere bi a ɛwɔ hɔ no so na woama nea ɛto so abiɛsa.
Sɛ Players ntumi nyɛ adwuma Wusuasua edison, game/loader versions, required mods, ne selected edition's actual port/protocol. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wufi a, hwɛ nea ɛto so abiɛsa no ho asɛm na wobehu sɛ ɛno yɛ adesua, runtime, memory, anaa dependency errors.

data.name: Content.29DD837D20479ABA0D1B
data.value:
Yi Satisfactory Control Center no adi bere a wofa API a ɛwɔ hɔ no ka ho. Paw adwuma a wohia no ho tab no.
ASƐM A ƐDA SO Paw Refresh de kenkan adesua din, nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn player count/limit, game state, median tick rate, play time, ne technology level.
dashboard player no di nkakrankakra berɛ a nkitahodi no yɛ den; Nkyerɛkyerɛmu ahodoɔ a edidisoɔ yi kyerɛ sɛ edidi so API yi ma nnipa a wɔwɔ din, na ɛnyɛ nnipakuw bi. Ɔfã bi a wɔasiesie anaa dwumadibea bi a ɛretwɛn ɔfã no nyɛ ade a wɔasiesie.
SERVER SETINGS Paw Refresh, yɛ nsakrae a wɔboa no, na afei fa nsesae. Kɔ so hwɛ nneɛma a ɛretwɛn no akyi. Nhwɛso ahorow bi hwehwɛ sɛ yɛsan fi ase; nsesaeɛ a wɔde di dwuma no nnyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛde hyɛ agodie ase bio.
Nkonim a wɔde di dwuma ne akatua a wogye tom no da so wɔ agodie no kasa mu.
ASƐM A WƆDE MAA • Kɔ so hwɛ seesei: Fa din bi hyɛ mu anaa fa din bi a wɔato din Synix di dwuma. Din a wɔde di dwuma bio no betumi atwe nsesae a ɛwɔ hɔ. • Adesoa a wɔapaw: Hwɛ nkontaabu no. Synix di kan twe nkɔanim a ɛrekɔ so seesei no to hɔ bere a adesua no reyɛ adwuma; adesoa betumi atwe agyinatufo no afi hɔ. • Twerɛtohɔ twe: Ɛde faenu a wɔapaw no ka ho na ebetumi asi din koro twe no ananmu. Ɛmfa ho sɛnea ɛte no, ɛnhyehyɛ no automatically. • Twerɛtohɔ a wɔapaw: Ɛde kɔbea fa kwan a wopaw no so.
Kɔ so nya backup a ɛsom bo ansa na woasiesie anaa wode wiase bi a ɛho hia asie. Akwantuo a wɔde gye sika no wɔ ahobammɔ hyeɛ a ɛne 512 MB. API ntumi nwie bere a dwumadi no redi dwuma.
ASƐM A ƐDA SO ƆKYERƐ Soma dwumadi krataa baako wɔ bere koro mu na kenkan nkonfirim no. Wɔasiw nkyerɛwee, nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn/ahyɛnsode ahyɛde, ne nsesae a enni ho kwan mu wɔ ha.
Wɔfa gyinapɛn gyinapɛn gyinapɛn a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran no di dwuma wɔ Synix gyinapɛn gyinapɛn adwuma mu. Ahyɛmu ntoasoɔ kɔtena mfɛnsere yi mu mmom sen sɛ wɔde to dashboard anaa Synix kyerɛwtohɔ nkrataa so; ebia agodie no bɛtumi akyerɛw n'ankasa nhyehyeɛ.

Synix de adansi-server nhyehyɛeɛ no si hɔ nanso ntumi ntwe, ntwe, anaa ntwe mpuntuo a wɔagye ho agyinatuo afiri agyinatuo no mu. Sɛ adwumakuo no bɔ amanneɛ sɛ nsɛm a ɛwɔ hɔ wɔ agodibea pii mu no ayera anaa atoyerɛnkyɛm aba bere a wɔrehyehyɛ anaa wɔresesa nsrahwɛ no a, fa Dark Messiah of Might & Magic Multiplayer kɔ Steam so de di dwuma wɔ twerɛtohɔ krataa a ɛyɛ ne dea no so. Twerɛ mpsrc bɔnbɔnbɔn ho nsɛm a ɛwɔ game no mu no bi kɔ fahodie yi so, na hwɛ sɛ mapcycle.txt ne maplist.txt wɔ nsɛm a wopɛ sɛ wotwa no mu.
Ɛwɔ sɛ obi a ɔhyehyɛ kɔmputa dwumadie no wie saa dwumadi yi. Game-type values yɛ 0 Deathmatch, 1 Team Deathmatch, 2 Crusade, 3 Capture the Flag, ne 4 Colosseum.

data.name: Content.2B637CF2169F0AD865CF
data.value:
Kenkan Connect awiei koraa ansa na worebɔ mmɔden bio. Ahyɛdeɛ bi a ɛwɔ game console no mu nkyerɛ sɛ token a wɔkyeree, wɔhwehwɛɛ, na wɔhyehyɛɛ no nyinaa dii nkonim.
Hwehwɛ ASƐM A WƆKYERƐ MU • Console no nni hɔ: Hu -NewConsole, ɔsomfoɔ a wɔapaw no no, ne Windows kwan ahorow a ɛne hyia no. • Ahyɛmu a enni awieɛ wɔ input no mu: Wo ara yi. Synix renkyerɛw ho. • Ahyɛmu no di dwuma nanso wɔankɔfa mfatoho biara: Ma dwumadi no awie, hwɛ game log a wobetumi akyerɛw no, na ma nneɛma foforo nyinaa mmra. • Filter a ɛhaw adwene: Kɔfa fa/pa filter no kɔ na ma console no mmuaeɛ. • API pon yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ foforɔ bi dea: Kɔ so teɛteɛ agyinatufoɔ a wɔasiesie no no pon. Nfa ne nsɛnkyerɛnne nkɔma obi a onnim nea ɔreyɛ. • Token a wɔapo no anaa nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn a wɔakora so no ntumi ntew: Di agorɔ no ankasa de si hɔ, na afei fa to mu bio. • API enni hɔ: Twɛn ma w'abɔ adwuma no afi ase anaa to hyɛ mu na hwɛ game log no.
Mmuae foforo bi betumi akyerɛ sɛ ɛsom bo te sɛ mmuaeɛ a edi kan no. Capture de output a wɔde di dwuma wɔ ahyɛde no akyi, na ɛnyɛ biribi dedaw bi a ɛwɔ log mu.
Bɔ wo ho ban anaa yi w'ani fi ho Satisfactory tintim administrator tokens wɔ n'ankasa console ne logs mu. Kɔ so yɛ wɔn ho kokoam na yi mfoni ahorow fi screenshots ne amanneɛbɔ mu.
Synix di adanseɛ sɛ local endpoint no yɛ server a wɔapaw no no dea na ɛtwe n'aseɛ. Mma nsɔhwɛ a wɔyɛ wɔ adansedi mu no nnyina so mma kwan mma wonsiesie ɔhaw bi.
Yi token a wɔakora so yi firi Synix's stored connection; ɛntwetwe token no wɔ server no so.
Sɛ wobɛpa application tokens a ɛwɔ hɔ no, fa server.InvalidateAPITokens di dwuma wɔ Satisfactory's own server console anaa Server Manager console mu. Eyi nso fa integrations afoforo a wɔde saa tokens no di dwuma ho.
Wɔ Windows account foforɔ anaa afiri a wɔatu akɔtena hɔ no ho, sɛ wontumi mfa ɛkwan a wɔakora so no nni dwuma a, twe kɔ bio.

data.value:
Kenkan ɔsomfo a woapaw no no dwumadi ne agokansie ho kyerɛwtohɔ foforo. Hwehwɛ ɔhaw a edi kan ankasa no mmom sen sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ ɔhaw a etwa to no.
ASƐM A ƐDA SO Mfiaseɛ anaa Mfiaseɛ 1. Hu fafa a wɔpaw no, fa no di dwuma, game edition, ne loader. 2. Hwehwɛ faelo a wohia, free RAM/disk space, ne ports a wɔagye. 3. Siesie apam biara, kyerɛwtohɔ a wode bɛhyɛ wo din mu, nsɛnkyerɛnne ho ahiade, anaa dwumadi a wobedi wɔ agodie no mu. 4. Wɔ mods ho no, fa toto agodie no, loader, dependencies, ne Client ahiade ho. 5. Siesie Synix ansa na woasesa nkrataa no, na afei bɔ mmɔden sɛ wobedi kan adi kan.
Sɛ kɔmputafo ankasa no di nkogu a, ɛbɔ a ɛwɔ hɔ no betumi atena hɔ. Ɛserɛfoɔ a wɔwɔ ahoɔden nso betumi atena hɔ retwɛn wiase load anaa wɔrennya mmuaeɛ/API. Hwehwɛ saa aman no mu nkutoo.
STOP OR RESTART gye bere Agodie gye bere de gye adwumayɛfo akwantu ne wɔn a wɔtwa toɔ. Twɛn Synix nsunsuanso no na kenkan n'abrabɔ nkra no. Sɛ wɔhyɛ obi ma ɔhwe ase a, ebetumi ama wanya nkɔso a enni mu.
Mfa nhyehyɛeɛ no nni dwuma prɛko pɛ, mmfi ase nnwinnade foforɔ, anaa mfa administrator foforɔ nyɛ adwuma wɔ asɔduro koro no ara ho.
Nnwinnade anaa nneɛma bi nni hɔ Hwehwɛ profile no tumi ne tebea a ɛwɔ hɔ seesei no mu. Nhwɛso ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛmfata esiane sɛ agodie no wɔ wɔn nti anaa nni hɔ a ɛhwɛ akwantu kwan so nti. N/A player data nyɛ automatically a server failure.
Sɛ ɔhaw no da so ara wɔ hɔ a, kyerɛw adeyɛ no, mfomso pɔtee no, ne kyerɛwtohɔ ketewaa bi ansa na woayɛ nsakrae foforo.

data.name: Content.3111DCC7482FEADC74FC
data.value:
Nkwampaefo a wɔwɔ Serwer ModPack 1. Wobeyi full-server backup na wobeyi server no adi. Wobeyɛ Synix ne normal Windows permissions. 2. Sete na fa pack no exact Minecraft version, loader, ne loader build di kan. 3. Wɔ Minecraft Control Center → Mods & Plugins mu no, yi Import Server Pack. Paw Modrinth .mrpack anaa server ZIP a ɛwie pɛyɛ a emu wɔ mods/plugins ne configuration files ankasa. 4. Wɔayi Server Mods a wontua ho ka biara asi nkyɛn, gye sɛ wɔayi Server Mods a wontua ho ka bi. W'ahwɛ ɔmofoɔ no nko ara Modrinth Nkrataa ahodoɔ a w'akyerew so nneema a ɛwɔ sɛ awofoɔ hunu wɔ wɔn nsa ano 5. Hwɛ scan no ho nsunsuanso, metadata nhwehwɛmu, nsɛm a wɔayi afi mu, ne ɔfã biara a ɛsɛ sɛ wode ka ho, sesa, anaa yi fi hɔ. Sɛ mfitiase ne nsesaeɛ yi fata a, ɛnde gye tom. 6. Wobekum nea ɛto so abiɛsa akyi no, ka konsole no ho, na wobegye n'asɛmti a ɛto so abiɛsa no.
Nnipa a wonni no, wobegye n'asɛmti no so, na wobegye n'asɛmti so, na wobegye n'asɛmti so server.properties. Wusuasua ɔkyerɛwfo's full server pack sɛ CurseForge klienti a ɛto so abiɛsa yɛ download manifest. Private downloads, unsupported hosts, or unsupported loader need the author's supported server files; Synix ntumi nnya nea ɔbea no bɛhyɛ no so.
Modrinth downloads no yɛ hash-check. Wɔhwɛ JAR metadata a wɔgye tom no so hwehwɛ nea ɛrehyehyɛ ade, nea ɛwɔ client-only mu, ID ahorow a wɔakyɛ, ne dependencies a wɔaka ho asɛm no bere a wɔnam JAR no so. Meta-data a wonnim ne nkyerɛase ahorow a emu yɛ den hia nhwehwɛmu. Nhwehwɛmu a emu da hɔ anaa nsonsonoe biara a wonhu mma wonhu sɛ mod bi di mu. Wɔmfa dependencies a ayera no ntwe ase wɔ kommyɛ mu.
Sɛ wo san de pack koro no ara di dwuma bio a, wobɛtumi ayi JARs a w'adi so dada a ɛnni hɔ bio no, nanso sɛ saa files no da so ne wɔn hashes a wɔatwerɛ no di nsɛ a. Wɔmfa JARs ne world files a wɔnhwɛ so nni dwuma no. Configuration files a new pack no de ma no betumi abesi nea atwam no ananmu; Mfonini no kyerɛ wɔn ansa na w'ahyɛ mu den. Fa server-ZIP fael din koro no ara di dwuma bere a woreyɛ saa pack no na ama wɔahu sɛ ɛyɛ pack koro no ara.
WORLD MANAGEMENT Fa Worlds ma kyerɛw akenkanfo no. Import World ZIP copy one matching-edition world into a new named folder; nea ɛto so abiɛsa no, ɛno nti, ɛnsɛ sɛ wogye adawurubɔfo a wɔwɔ asase so ho adi, na ɛnsɛ sɛ wokɔfa Java ne Bedrock ho. Choose an installed world and Activate World to change level-name and Synix's world setting together. Nneɛma a ɛto so abiɛsa no bɛtow nea wɔhyew no. Nkurɔfo a wɔasra wɔn no yɛ nnipa a wɔwɔ asase so nyinaa, na ɛnyɛ nnipa a wɔwɔ asase so nyinaa.
NKURƆFO Ayaresa yi kyerɛ nsakrae a wɔayɛ wɔ saa adwumam ha no. Undo siesie nkrataa a w'atwerɛ dada no anaa yi nkrataa a saa nsesaeɛ no de aba no. Twe wo ho fi wiase foforo bi ho ansa na woasesa n'ahyehyɛde no. Sɛ wɔasesa files no akyiri yi a, Synix ampene so sɛ ɔbɛtwerɛ ne so; fa nsesaeɛ no sie, na sɛ ɛho behia a, fa backup no nyinaa yɛ adwuma.
A pending recovery blocks Start till recovery finishes and the saved entry agrees with the restored files. Nkwampaefo a wɔasra wɔn a wonni runtime profile reyɛ full backup for runtime recovery. Backups befi server-folder backups, independent of individual change records.
Bere a w'atumi asan de backup no adi dwuma awie no, wo bɛkyerɛ sɛ saa backup no asesa nneɛma dedaw no. Wɔda so ara wɔ hɔ sɛ adansedie, nanso wontumi mfa nyɛ adwuma wɔ nsɛm a wɔasan de asi hɔ no ho. Nsɛm a w'ayi no adi anaa w'akyerɛ mu wɔ bere a woasan de asi hɔ akyi no yɛ nkaedum foforo.
Diagnostics ne Schedule Diagnostics kenkan atesɛm nkrataa ne nsɛm a asisi nnansa yi ara ho amanneɛbɔ de hwehwɛ ɔhaw ahorow a ɛtaa ba no bi te sɛ Java, nkae, apɔwmuden, port, wiase ne tick-time. Nsɛ sɛnea yɛhu no kyerɛ sɛ nkyerɛkyerɛfo no yɛ pa ara. Performance buee resource monitor no; CPU and RAM measurements do not replace the profiling of game ticks.
Schedules buee Synix's reset na maintenance settings a ɛwɔ hɔ. Paw nna a wopɛ, bere, player-wait suban, backup, ne update akwan, afei hwɛ na kora so. Adwumayɛbea no ntumi nyɛ nhyehyeɛfoɔ a ɔtɔ so mmienu anaa ɛnsesa w'ahyehyɛdeɛ no mu.

data.name: Content.34AD8EEA90B225512F6F
data.value:
Paw Minecraft dwumadifoɔ no, na bue Server Options → Minecraft Control Center. Console ne Players nkratafa no ma akwankyerɛ ne player nnwinnade yɛ baako. Nkrataafa afoforo de asetena, ewiase, add-ons, nkwammoaa a wɔde di dwuma nyinaa, nhyehyɛe foforo a wɔde di dwuma, adesoa, ne nhwehwɛmu.
ASƐM A ƐDA SO Nhyehyɛɛ a wɔboa no bɛtumi de Synix-di dwuma afiri, localhost management channel a wɔboa no, anaa RCON a wɔpaw no. Ɔfã a ɛwɔ hɔ no gyina nhyehyeɛ ne server configuration so.
Nkrataa a wɔde sie wɔ n'ankasa mfɛnsere mu no betumi ama ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ ɛwɔ baabi a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran. Sɛ wɔasiesie nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma no a, hwɛ sɛ server no reyɛ adwuma na ne nnwinnade a wɔde di dwuma no yɛ papa.
ASƐM A Wɔasiesie Sɛ wɔboa no a, Synix de amanneɛbɔ, agodifoɔ ho nsɛm a ɛwɔ din no di dwuma, moderation, operator ne allowlist nsakrae, bere/anwummerɛ controls, ne adedodoɔ.
Paw player a wopɛ na kenkan dwumadi no ansa na woahyɛ ho bɔ. Ɛma dwumadifoɔ no kwan ma wotumi di agorɔ tumi. Mma saa kwan yi so sɛ wobesiesie abusuabɔ mu haw bi kɛkɛ.
ASƐM NSƐM Fa asɛmfua a ɛwɔ nhoma no mu no di dwuma. Ahyɛdeɛ te sɛ list ne save-all yɛ game input na wɔnnkyerɛ ase wɔ Synix interface no mu. Hwehwɛ agyinatuo a ɛwɔ agyinatuo no mu ansa na woasoma ahyɛde bi a ɛsakra wiase anaa ahofadi.
ASƐM NE NNIPA Nsɛmmisa bi betumi ama obi adi agorɔ a onni din a wɔagye din. Nkrataa a enni hɔ no ankasa nkyerɛ sɛ obiara nni hɔ a ne ho akyekyere.
Fa dashboard no gyina anaa san fi ase dwumadi no di dwuma wɔ nkwa nna nsakrae ho sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɔhwɛfo no nim sɛ wɔhyɛ da tua adwuma no.
Fa RCON anaa administration endpoints no di dwuma wɔ hɔ gye sɛ wowɔ akyirikyiri nnwinnadeɛ ho nhyehyɛe. Amansan gameplay no nhwehwɛ sɛ obi bɛyi saa credentials anaa endpoints no adi.

13. Live Activity Counter ne ahobanbɔ
Synix kyerɛkyerɛ ne mu sɛ ɛnsɛ sɛ yɛkɔ so hwehwɛ nea ɛrekɔ so wɔ Synix session no mu wɔ https://synix.info. mu. You can turn it off anytime in Settings> Privacy & Security> Share active count without limiting other Synix features. Nkyekyɛm a ɛto so abiɛsa a wɔfrɛ no "off" no yɛ den.
Berɛ a w'ama no kwan no, Synix de HTTPS presense signal kɔma https://synix.info/api/presence wɔ abɛɛfo berɛ mu ne bɛyɛ sɛ simma biara 10 berɛ a app no redi dwuma no, a nea ɛka ho ne background. 14. Remote Access Privilege and Security
14.1 Opt-in Access and No Sale of Data (Asɛm a Ɛto So)
Remote management wɔ https://manager.synix.info yɛ nea w'ani bɛgye ho na woayi no afi hɔ kɔsi sɛ wobɛnya kɔmputa bi na woagye account a ɛrebisa no atom wɔ Synix app no so wɔ saa kɔmputa no so. Synix mfa saa nsɛm yi nyɛ targeted advertising anaa ɛnnyɛ advertising profiles. Wɔde nsɛm no yɛ adwuma ma wode nneɛma a woayi no di dwuma, di dwuma, na ɛbɔ ho ban fi basabasayɛ ho.
Remote access nyɛ dwumadie a ɛnni nkaebea. Ɔhia nkaeɛbɔ a' edidisoɔ, ayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ, ɛne ahobanbɔ a' edidi so yi. Wɔmfa saa nkrataa yi nto dwa wɔ ɔman no dwumadi twerɛtohɔ twerɛtohɔ krataa no mu, na wɔn nso mfa nni dwuma mma ɔhwɛsofoɔ foforo twerɛtohɔ twerɛtohɔ twerɛtohɔ twerɛtohɔ twerɛtohɔ twerɛtohɔ krataa.
14.2 Nsɛm a Ɛwɔ Wo Kompɔti So
Synix ntumi ntwe game worlds, game server files, configuration file contents, backup archive contents, console raw output, anaa saved game server passwords. ɛyɛ afidie a wɔn de ka nsɛm kyerɛ kɔmputa ho a wɔn de ka nsɛm kyerɛ amonomuhɔa; Backup no kɔ so wɔ baabi a wɔahyehyɛ no. Sɛ wo paw sɛ wobɛkyerɛw agodie console akwankyerɛ bi wɔ wɛbsaet no so a, ne nkyerɛwee no bɛyɛ adwuma na wɔde akɔto kɔmputa foforo no so, ɛne ntease afotusɛm biara a wode bɛhyɛ saa nkyerɛwee no mu. Driver no nyɛ cloud backup storage, na ɛmma kwan mma remote desk, command prompt access Windows, anaa general file navigation.
Synix kora n'afedie, server list, abakɔsɛm, backup, ne pairing status wɔ wo kɔmputa so. Kɔmputa a w'akyekyere no, ne private signing key no bɛtena Windows key storage mu. Synix pɛ storage a ɛgyina TPM so bere a ebi wɔ hɔ, na sɛ ɛnte saa a, ɛgyina Windows-protected software key so. TPM a ɛwɔ hɔ no nkyerɛ sɛ kɔmputa bi ntumi nyɛ adwuma.
Saa nsɛm yi kyerɛkyerɛ Synix akyirikyiri akwankyerɛ mu. Agorɔ, Steam, mods, Discord nkabom, akwantuo, ne mmoa ho amanneɛbɔ a woayi sɛ wobɛkyekyɛ no wɔ wɔn ankasa data mu. Mma password anaa nsɛm foforo a ɛho hia nhyɛ kɔmputa din, servers din, anaa backup file din mu, efisɛ saa nkrataafa yi betumi ada adi wɔ manager no mu.
14.3 Nimdeɛ a ɔhwɛ so no yɛ adwuma na ɔde sie
- Account ne authentication: Wo user name, account identifier, adebɔ bere, security preferences, a salted password hash, encrypted authenticator secret when enabled, passkey public credentials when enabled, and temporary verification/session records. Nkrataa ahodoɔ a w'akyerew so nneema a ɛwɔ sɛ awofoɔ hunu wɔ wɔn nsa ano permanent passwords wonhyehyɛ no sɛ text a wotumi kenkan. Synix nnye wo nsateaa ano nkyerɛwee, w'anim mfonini, ahyɛnsode, anaa kɔmputa no ahyɛnsode. Ɛnsɛ sɛ wode wo din ankasa anaa wo e-mail address di dwuma ansa na woatumi de wo ho ahyɛ krataa mu. - Pairing ne connection: Kɔmputa no din a woayi, afidie no identifier a w'ayi no kwa, ne signing key no, account association, key-provider type no, pairing approval status, ne last connection time. Sɛ Synix yɛ adwuma a, wobɛtumi abue ɛkwan ama website no atumi ayi app no adi ntɛm ara. Relay no fa wake/disconnect ho nkrataa ne connection metadata, ɛnyɛ game files anaa server snapshots. - Status displayed: Limited server identifiers, names, game names, run status, number of players, uptime, available actions, last time/save status, combined CPU and RAM readings of running game server processes (including their launchers and tracked workers), and separate CPU for the whole computer, RAM/total used and network send/receive rate. Computer network tariffs include LAN traffic on active gateway adapters; Adapter IDs, IP addresses, packet contents, and navigation destinations are not sent with these readings. Saa nhyehyeɛ yi firi app no hɔ bere a authenticated manager view no yɛ adwuma. CPUMeze kɛzi menli fa bɛ nwo agɔnwolɛ la .RAM updates covers matched computers; server no nkyerɛkyerɛmu nkyerɛkyerɛmu no fa kɔmputa a w'ayi no asi hɔ. Nsɛnkyerɛnne no bɛtoa so nnɔnhwerew 10 biara, na ɛbɛto mu bere a w'atwe wo ho afi dwumadi no ho, w'ayi w'ani asi so, anaa w'ayi w'ani asi so. Browser dwumadi a aka no bɛtumi ama wɔn ankasa ani so bere a wɔreyɛ adwuma no. - Actions and backups requested: server identifiers/action, time of request, progress/result, and, when you request backup choices, backup identifiers, file names, dates, sizes, and integrity labels. Wɔamfa backup mu nsɛm ne baabi a wɔfa so kɔ no nyinaa ankyerɛ saa kwan yi so. - Agorɔ-console akwankyerɛ: Agorɔ-run ahwehwɛde a aniwa nhu, bere tiaa mu a w'agye ato hɔ, ne akwankyerɛ nkyerɛwee a wode ma no. Wɔkyerɛw nsɛm a wɔretwɛn no wɔ adwuma no database mu na wɔyi fi saa kyerɛwtohɔ no mu bere a wɔama ho kwan no. Wɔmfa nni dwuma nnansa yi adeyɛ din mu anaa adansedi-alarm kyerɛwtohɔ mu. Nkyerɛkyerɛmu a w'ayi no adi kyerɛ sɛ text no na wɔde ama agodie no, na ɛnyɛ sɛ agodie no agye ato mu anaa awie no. Agorɔ mmuaeɛ ne amansan nhyehyɛeɛ dua no nni hɔ. - Sekuridad ne abuse prevención: Failed sign-in type, grouped attempt count and times, recovery/security event type, ne relevant computer labels. Short-lived rate-limit records bɛtumi ayɛ keyed hashes of connection IP addresses and account identifiers. Synix's account-alert records don't contain tried passwords, verification codes, raw IP addresses, or browser fingerprints. Hosting ahwɛfo bi bɛtumi ayɛ nea ɛto so abiɛsa sɛ wɔbɛfa akenkan no ho asɛm wɔ Section 14.6 mu.
The website necessarily processes the allowed summaries and commands to provide remote management. HTTPS ne encrypted relay connections kyekyere traffic in transit; eyi nti, ɛmfa ho sɛ host service no nni hɔ a obetumi ayɛ nea ɛho hia.
14.4 Retention ne Deletion
- Account credentials ne settings no bɛtena hɔ kosi sɛ wobeyi account no afi hɔ. Mfonini a wɔagye ato mu no bɛkɔ so ara atena hɔ kosi sɛ wɔbɛyi kɔmputa no afi mu anaa wobetu account no agu. - Status snapshots ne CPU / RAM akenkan no rekasa wɔ nea ɛto so abien akenkannom mu na wobenya ahotoso sɛ wobegye wɔn ho adi wɔ 15 akenkannom mu. Ɔkwan a ɛto so abiɛsa no yɛ nea ɛto so abiɛsa. - Remote control records, results, and returned backup selection metadata become eligible for cleanup after 24 hours. - Agorɔhyɛde a wɔretwɛn no ba awiei wɔ anibu 30 akyi. Asɛm a w'ankyerɛw no bɛtumi ayɛ sɛ wobetu no agu bere a ne twerɛtohɔ no aba awiei anaa wɔasan agye ato mu; a wɔagye ato mu sɛ wɔde bɛma no ntɛm ara. Dwumadibea ho nhyehyeɛ ba awiei wɔ simma abiɛsa mu. Action identifier ne fixed delivery result no di 24-hour action-record period no akyi. - Recovery/safety events and faulty connection reports become eligible for cleanup after 90 days. Nsɛmfua a wɔbɛyɛ a wɔbɛyɛ no mfa nsɛmfua 100 a ɛwɔ akyiri no nka ho; Akwankyerɛ a' yɛde bɛto dwa wɔ mmrɛ a' ɛboro simma 10 mu no nyinaa aka abom. - Browser dwumadi no ba awiei bere a 30 simma kakra a manager no mmisa anaa 8 nnɔnhwerew no nyinaa mu. Verification attempts expire after 5 minutes; temporary-password recovery wie wɔ simma 10 mu na wɔde di dwuma prɛko. Wɔyi nkrataa a wɔayi no adi wɔ bere a wɔresɛe nneɛma, wɔresane ayi no bio, wɔde rebɔ ho ban, ne nea wɔayi no adi wɔ bere a wɔresɛe nneɛma no. Nkrataa a enni mu no bɛtumi ama wɔasiesie wɔ nnɔnhwere 24 akyi.
Mmerɛ a nkrataa no hyɛ ase ba awiei no, tumi gyina ansa na wɔayi afiri hɔ mpo. Database ho banbɔ ho nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde asi hɔ no bɛyɛ adwuma berɛ a wɔbɛyɛ nsɛm no so nsɛm biara, ɛno ara ne sɛ mmrɛ 10 biara ma manager ho banbɔ, enti mmere a wɔka ho asɛm no yɛ bere a ahobanbɔ anaa banbɔ ho nhyehyɛeɛ ho nhyehyɛe ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde asi hɔ no mmom na wɔhyɛ bɔ sɛ wobetu no agu bere pɔtee bi. Ɔhwɛfoɔ no log ne backup no wɔ wɔn nkwa nna a ɛsono.
Unpairing yi nhyehyɛe a wapaw no ne akyirikyiri nkrataa a ɛfa ho no fi adwuma a w'ayɛ no mu. Ɔgyeɛ/ahotɔ abakɔsɛm bɛtumi akɔ so wɔ account no mu wɔ mmerɛ a yɛaka ho asɛm wɔ atifi hɔ no. Sɛ wo yi manager account a, woyi ne credentials, pairings, snapshots, commands, ne account security/recovery records firi active service database no mu. Ɛmpopa wo amantam agodie servers, ewiase, settings, anaa backup files. Akwankyerɛ a' yɛde bɔ ahohwisɛm ho ban ne logs anaa backup ahorow a' ɔhwɛsofoɔ no kura no ɛnsoso sɛ ɛbɛsesa bere biara denam adeɛ yi mu biara so.
14.5 Wo Controls ne Sign-in Protection
Ɛho hia sɛ wode wo password ne password anaa authenticator a ɛwɔ hɔ, te sɛ Google Authenticator. Asɛdeɛ a wɔasiesie sɛ ɛbɛhia sɛ wɔde akwan mmienu no nyinaa di dwuma no ma ɛho hia sɛ wɔde akwan mmienu no nyinaa di dwuma. Sɛ wobɛsesa wo password, na woayi kɔmputa bi afi wɛbsaet no so, na wo ayi manager account bi afiri hɔ a, ɛhia sɛ wosɔ saa nsakrae no mu bio.
Sɛ wobɛtumi abue custom game-console input no a, ɛhia sɛ wode account no password ne verification foforɔ di dwuma. Nkrataa a w'agye ato mu no fa browser baako, kɔmputa a w'akɔ ne ho so, server a w'agye ato mu ne agodie a w'atumi de adi dwuma simma mmiɛnsa. Sɛ obi gyae, san hyɛ aseɛ bio, na wabue console no so, na wabue console no so, anaa ɔfa bi ayera a, ɔremma kwan mma ɔnkɔ so nni dwuma bio. Sɛ wo twe anaa wode administrator tab no sie a, ɛno bɛma tab no agye atom. Normal server-action buttons no kura wɔn sign-in ahwehwɛde a ɛwɔ hɔ no so. Agorɔ bi a w'atumi de adi dwuma wɔ afidie no so nko ara na ɛfata; Unique identifier nkoara mma kwan sɛ wobɛtwerɛ asɛm bi akɔ Windows command prompt mu.
Sɛ wo werɛ fi wo wɛbsaet no ano asɛm a, kɔmputa bi a w'apene so dada no betumi de bere tiaa mu ano asɛm ama wo. Ɛntumi mpɛ account foforo. Temporary password no mfa wo passkey/authenticator ahwehwɛde a ɛwɔ hɔ no nyɛ adwuma, na ɛsɛ sɛ wo paw password foforo ansa na woakɔ manager no mu. Sɛ wuwie ɔsesɛw no a, w'afiri wo browser dwumadi afoforo no so.
Synix's manager kora ne browser login token no wɔ current tab no nkae mu, ɛnyɛ cookies, local storage, anaa session storage mu. Sɛ wosan twe tab no bio anaa wusi mu a, wo bɛhwere saa login no. Eyi nsiw wo browser anaa password manager no kwan sɛ ɔnkora credentials a wopɛ so, na ɛnkyerɛ cookies a wɔn a wɔhwɛ dwumadie/ahoban ho nsɛm so anaa wɛbsaet no nkyerɛase adwuma no de ato hɔ.
You can log out, cancel all browser sessions, or unpair a computer. The local Synix app can disable and unpair its remote connection without logging in to the website. Sɛ woyɛ offline a, wobekum remote access locally na wobegye nea wubetumi biara wɔ web site no so. Restarting the app or Windows %s:%u/%u Local-only usage remains available.
14.6 Hosting, Public Pages, ne Security Limits
Ɔwɛn-Aban no yɛ OpenAI's Sites hosting ne Cloudflare services a ɛto so abiɛsa a ɛwɔ hɔ ma nsɛnkyerɛnne, nyimpa, sɛkyeti, ne wake relay. Ɛno akyi no, wɔn a wɔasra wɔn no reyɛ nea ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ ma wɔanya adwuma no, na wobenya IP adware, request headers, akokoduru, ne nea ɛto so abiɛsa metadata, anaa wonnya wɔn ho operational logs ne back-up copies. Wɔn privacy policy no kyerɛ sɛ wɔne wɔn ho yɛ adwuma: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/ ne https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/.
Public-page automatic translation and GitHub downloads involve their respective providers. The private manager is separated from the public pages and does not load the public translation provider or advertising scripts. Synix ntumi nnya awerɛhyem sɛ nea ɛto so abiɛsa no bɛtumi ayɛ cookies, logs, anaa data. Nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ no, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔkyerɛ ase bere a ɛho hia. no-sale commitment a ɛto so abiɛsa no, ɛmfa ho sɛ ɛho hia hosting anaa legal disclosures.
Synix de authenticated pairing, signed computer requests, encrypted network connections, account access checks, ne short-lived approvals reuses to reduce unauthorized access. Ɛno nti, ɛmfa ho sɛ ɛho hia paa sɛ yɛma nea yebetumi biara ayɛ nea yebetumi biara anaa yɛma yɛn ani gye ho sɛ yebetumi ayɛ nea yebetumi biara ama yɛn ho anyɛ bɔne, sɛ yɛn kɔmputa/brawzer abɛka yɛn ho a, sɛ yɛbɛka yɛn ani gye ho a, anaa sɛ yɛbɛka yɛn adwuma abɛka yɛn ho a. Wɔde Synix ne Windows kyekyere, na wo ne w'akyidifo ne w'abɛnfo no bɛtena ase, na woabisa kɔmputa ne akyidifo a woyɛ wɔn so.
Saa adiyisɛm yi wɔ badwam wɔ https://synix.info/license/ na wɔde aka app no Help Center ne installer no ho. Wobɛtumi de nsɛmmisa a ɛfa ahobanbɔ ho abrɛ aban mmoa no wɔ https://synix.info/support/. Nkyerɛw wo password, recovery codes, anaa wo nkontae ho nsɛm foforo wɔ mmoa nkrataa a ɛwɔ baguam no mu. Saa nkitahodie yi ho nsesaeɛ ne da a' yɛde bɛto dwa.

Ma Ɔhaw No Nnya Nkɔso Bio Fa ɔkwan a wɔde si hɔ no ka ho, Synix ne Windows nkyerɛase a wo de di dwuma ankasa, game/profile, ne edition/loader ho nsɛm a ɛfa ho.
Kyerɛkyerɛ mu: • Nea woahwɛ so anaa woasesa. • Nea wohwɛ kwan ne nea esii. • Mfomso a edi mũ no ne nhoma mmobɔwee ketewa bi a ɛbɛn ne bere. • Sɛ nhyehyɛe no yɛɛ adwuma ansa na wɔreyɛ no anaa nea ɛsesae.
dwen ho ansa na w'akyɛ Yi akwankyerɛ, tokens, webhook URL, akwankyerɛ a w'ani gye ho, ne network nsɛm a wompɛ sɛ wobehu. Ahɔhobea kwan no ntew adansedi biara a wɔde ka ho. Mfa nhyiamu nkrataa anaa game configurations nyinaa nka ho a wonnhwɛ mu.
Sɛ wopɛ nkyerɛase ho asɛm bi a, fa kasa a wɔapaw no, mfɛnsere din, ne nsɛmfua a ɛda adi pɛpɛɛpɛ no ka ho. Deɛ ɛfa agodie nkyerɛkyerɛmu ho no, fa agodie ne agodie a ɛfa agodie ho kyerɛwtohɔ no ka ho.
ASƐM A ƐDA SO Nkyerɛkyerɛmu wɔ diberɛ ahodoɔ mu: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/issues
Community Discord: https://discord.gg/WduKEU3j8s
Adwumayɛbea: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel
Nhyehyɛe a edi mũ a wɔde si hɔ anaa wɔasiesie ntumi nsɔ agodie, mod, ne kɔmputa mu nsɛm tebea biara nhwɛ. Nkyerɛkyerɛmu akwankyerɛ a emu da hɔ no boa ma yɛhyɛ Synix nsɛm afiri bɔne anaa host-setup nsɛm mu.

Hwehwɛ server adaka bi mu ansa na wode control no adi dwuma wɔ ase hɔ. Ahyehyɛde a wɔpaw no gyina hɔ ma dwuma bi a ɛrefa so aba dwumadibea bɛn.
Hwehwɛ Ɔsomfo Fa nhwehwɛ adaka no di dwuma de di dwuma wɔ agodie anaa nkatabo din mu. Akwankyerɛ paneɛ no twe nsesae no kɔ akyiri. Sɛ adansedi bi te sɛ nea ɛfi hɔ a, yi nsɛso mmienu nyinaa firi hɔ ansa na woahu sɛ wɔayi no afi hɔ.
KENKENKENKENKENKENKENN • Servers a wɔde asi hɔ no di dwuma de kenkan servers a wɔayɛ ho kyerɛwtohɔ no. • Running Now da nsɛm a seesei wɔde adi dwuma no adi. • CPU Usage ne RAM Usage ka PC no nyinaa ho asɛm, ɛnyɛ Synix nko. • Sɛ agodie a wɔapaw no ma obi hu baabi a wɔboa no a, ɛno nko ara na wɔde player data di dwuma.
DABESƐN NNIPA A WƆHWƐ • Start, Stop, ne Restart di dwuma wɔ server a woapaw no so. • Ɔhyehyɛ no bue ne setup fields. • Sɛ obi siesie ne ho a, ɔhwɛ nneɛma a ebetumi ama ayɛ yiye no so. • Server Options wɔ faelo, nsiesie, nkitahodi, ne agodie ho nneɛma pɔtee bi. • Hwehwɛ kɔmputa so dwumadibea no ho nsɛm pii.
Adwuma & Nyansapɛ da nkɔso ne kɔkɔbɔ a ɛfa ho adi. Kenkan asɛm a etwa to no ansa na woasusuw biribi ho. CLEAR ma dwumadie no ho yɛ den; ɛnnyɛ ahyɛde a wɔde bɛpopa nkrataa nkrataa nyinaa.
Ɛnyɛ bere nyinaa na obi a ɔreyɛ adwuma no ayɛ krado ama ne nsa aka. Sɛ ɛba saa a, wobetumi akɔ so de asi hɔ, wɔde ahyɛ wiase nyinaa mu, nhyehyɛe ahorow, ne agodie a wɔde si hɔ. Siesie wo ho sɛ wowɔ ahoboa wɔ agodie nhoma no mu na fa wo ho hyɛ mu.

Workflow Types Workflows a wɔboa so no bi ne Minecraft JAR packages, Rust Oxide/uMod plugins, local 7 Days to Die packages, Empyrion scenarios ne server mods, ARK: Survival Evolved Workshop IDs, ne ARK: Survival Ascended provider IDs. An unavailable or inconclusive Defender scan is a warning, not a proof of malware. A clean scan and recorded hash also does not prove a third-party package is trustworthy. Mods rekɔ so wɔ serwer's Windows permissions.

Nneɛma a ɛto so abiɛsa yi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛba nea ɛto so abiɛsa no mu, privacy/security options, problem reporting, ne advanced/background settings. Woannyɛ sɛ wopɛ sɛ wobɛyɛ avanced options na woayi anormal server.

Nkyerɛwee a ɛfa agodie ho no ntwerɛ ase: commands, configuration keys and values, map names, modes, filenames, launch arguments, identifiers, and output-recognition text must remain in the form the game expects.
Sɛ wogye interfeasi asɛmfua adi a, wonnim sɛ wobegye nea ɛto so abiɛsa no. Sɛ ordinary Synix label yɛ a obetumi aka no, report its exact wording, window, and selected language.

ASƐM A ƐDA SO Kɔ so yɛ Synix ne game servers a wɔde gyinapɛn Windows kwan di dwuma. Nhyehyɛeɛ foforɔ anaa game launcher bi bɛtumi abɔ ho dawuro wɔ baabiara; ɛno nyɛ biribi a ɛbɛma woatumi adi biribiara so afebɔɔ sɛ administrator.
Nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa firewall ho a ɛho hia ho no boaa Synix-de nnyinasosɛm a atwam. Hyɛ mmara a wɔahyehyɛ no mu nhwehwɛmu ansa na wɔagye ntwetweɛ no atom. Ɛnhyehyɛ nkatafo nkatabo biara anaa ɛmma kwan sɛ wobeyi firewall mmara a ɛnka ho.

Mmofra mfɛnsere bi a wobetwa, Synix a wobetwitwa so, ne nkrataa no a wobetu afi mu no yɛ nnwuma horow. Hwɛ w'akwankyerɛ a woasiesie ne ɛho nsrɛ biara a wobɛyɛ de afi hɔ.
ASƐM A ƐKYERƐ SO NNIPA Synix bɛtumi ahunu server nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔgye di a wɔda so ara reyɛ adwuma na wɔasan anya wɔn so mfasoɔ. Ma nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛdi kan no mmra awiei ansa na woahyɛ aseɛ foforɔ.
Ɛsɛ sɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ho nimdeɛ no ne afiri a wɔapaw no hyia, na ɛnyɛ edin a wonim no kɛkɛ a wɔde di dwuma. Nhyehyɛɛ a wɔde hyɛ nkatabo anaa nnwinnade a wɔde di dwuma wɔ amannɔne mu no betumi ahwehwɛ atenka a ɛboro saa.
ASƐM A ƐDA SO NSƐM A ƐDA SO Optional startup/background-agent setup support monitoring at Windows sign-in. Ɛnsɛ sɛ wobɔ wo dibea a edi kan no.
Adwuma a wɔahyehyɛ no hia Synix nhyehyɛeɛ anaa agyinatufoɔ a ɛfa ho, Windows adesua a ɛwɔ hɔ, ne kɔmputa a ɛrebɔ. Sigin-in start nyɛ bɔhyɛ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ adwuma no bɛkɔ so bere a afiri no apue.
Ansa na WƆBƐYƐ ASƐM foforo Kɔ so nya backup, twe, na twe. Yi agorɔ firi Synix so na wɔatumi de adi dwuma sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ, na afei fi hɔ anaa to Windows ase bio.
Mma w'adwene ntena so sɛ agodibea bi a ahintaw no agyae anaa sɛ wusiesie afiri bi a ɛhwɛ nneɛma so a, ɛno na ɛma agodibea no gyae adwuma. Hwehwɛ dashboard no mu na fa nkwa nna controls yɛ adwuma.

data.name: Content.57A2257D55B43047831A
data.value:
Bue server a wɔapaw no no Readyness nsunsuanso no na woahu tebea a ɛhia a ɛhia. Synix a wɔde di dwuma no ntena hɔ mma agodie biara ho ahiadeɛ.
DLL MESSAGES a Wɔayera Mfomso a ɛfa MSVCP140.dll anaa VCRUNTIME140.dll ho no taa kyerɛ Visual C++ runtime ahiadeɛ. Fa agyinatuo a ɛwɔ agyinatuo no mu ne Microsoft adansedeɛ a wɔde di dwuma no di dwuma.
Microsoft's redistributable information: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/latest-supported-vc-redist
Mfa DLL nketewa nnto hɔ mfiri wɛbsaet biara so anaa mfa DLL a ɛnfa ho ntena ɛboɔ a wɔde di dwuma no ho.
ASƐM A ƐDA SO Agodie bi betumi ahwehwɛ twerɛtohɔ krataa, server entitlement, soronko Java runtime, Windows dwumadie, anaa hardware a wɔboa. Fa saa ahiadeɛ no wie ansa na woasesa port a ɛnfa ne ho anaa woasesa wɔ configuration no.
Minecraft Java de, fa version/loader combination a wɔboa firi Synix's selectors no so. Bedrock mmfa Java nyɛ adwuma.
Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wohyɛ adwuma bi mu a ɛhia Hyper-V anaa hardware virtualization a, hwɛ ne game-specific readiness checks. Mma system dwumadie no nyɛ adwuma anaa mfa nkatabo biara nni dwuma sɛ administrator na woatwe ho afiri kɔkɔbɔ bi ho.
Sɛ woahyɛ mmara no ho ban wie a, di kan fi ase foforo na hwɛ game-log mfomso a edi kan a ɛho hia no sɛ ɛsan yɛ yie.

data.name: Content.5C88F49381905FBD8C70
data.value:
ASƐM A ƐDA SO:
1. Synix buee Space Engineers Dedicated Server Manager no na ɛhwɛ so daa.
2. Paw 'Local/Console', paw 'Continue to server configuration', fa wo server ne wiase asetena, afei paw 'Save & start'.
3. Fa Manager no di dwuma ma asetena a ɛkɔ anim, wiase ahorow, mods, ahwɛfo, ne teaseɛnam no. Server data yi wɔ Synix server no Instance folder yi mu.
4. Deɛ ɛdi kan no, Local/Console mode no nhwehwɛ administrator rights. Windows adwuma kwan no yɛ yie.
5. Ehia: .NET Framework 4.8 anaa foforɔ, Visual C++ Redistributable 2013 ne 2017, anyɛ yie koraa no 6 GB a ɛwɔ nhyehyɛe RAM mu, ne UDP port 27016 a wɔde fa Windows Firewall so de kɔma Intanɛt anim.
6. Nkrataa ahodoɔ a etwa sɛ yɛhyehyɛ wɔ kasa ahodoɔ mu - Official Documentation: https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/dedicated-servers/

Synix bɛfa nnwumakuo a wɔde di dwuma no fa nnoɔma no ho ntɛmntɛm.

data.name: Content.5D3A53B459DA2A7A26AF
data.value:
Wubetumi ayɛ no bere a LAN-play no yɛ adwuma na public-address test no yɛ den.
WO NEA W’ADWƐM A ƐSƐ ADWƐM A ƐSƐ ADWƐM Some routers don't support NAT loopback, aka hairpinning. Ntam a efi fie hɔ kɔ n'ankasa address so no betumi adi nkogu bere mpo a nnipa a wɔwɔ abɔnten betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ mu.
Wubetumi de LAN adware a ɛwɔ wo nkyɛn na wobisa obi a ɔyɛ internet komputa no sɛ ɔbɛte ase wɔ adware a ɛwɔ hɔ mu. A failed in-PC WAN probe biara nni hɔ a ɛyɛ hu de internet outage.
PORT FORWARDING MA NEA ƐSƐM Hwehwɛ router foforɔ a wɔwɔ soro no, NAT mmienu, anaa carrier-grade NAT (CGNAT). Fa router no WAN ho nsɛm toto badwam address no ho, na bisa ISP no sɛ wogye inbound connections tom anaa.
Wontumi mfa wo router no so nhyehyɛe kwan a ɛbɛfa so ama w'abɔfo no adi dwuma na w'atumi abue NAT. Ɛdefa nkitahodi no ho no, wobɛtumi ahwehwɛ public-address service, a ɔfata VPN/tunnel, anaa hosted server. Eyinom yɛ nhyehyɛe a enni mu, na ɛnyɛ nea wɔde Synix asiesie mu.
Don't confuse management with player access Remote-control connection ne game's player connection yɛ paths a ɛto so abien. Sɛ woyɛ local API or Discord notification a, ɛmfa ho sɛ ɛno na ɛbɛboa wo ma woatumi asua nsɛnkyerɛnne yi wɔ Intanɛt so.
Wobenya nea ɛto so abiɛsa a nea ɛto so abiɛsa a ɛto so abiɛsa na ɛto so abiɛsa a ɛto so abiɛsa a ɛto so abiɛsa. Sɛ wopɛ nhyira so ara a, ɛnde monkɔ so mapasword, tokens, router screen shots, anaa private network details.

data.name: Content.6B534A2A8D64DD2115B8
data.value:
Fa kyerɛwtohɔ no di dwuma a ɛfa nea ewiee ase no ho.
SYNIX ASƐM Activity & Diagnostics da nkɔso ne kɔkɔbɔ a ɛfa obi ho adi wɔ dashboard no so. Sɛ wɔpopa saa beae no a, ɛpaapae nkrabɔ a ɛwɔ hɔ no mu nko ara; ɛnkunkum nyansapɛ a wɔakora so nyinaa.
ASƐM MU NKYERƐKYERƐ Synix text logs ne fatale-crash reports wɔ amanneɛ so: C:\Synix\SynixData\logs
Nsonsonoe a ɛrekɔ so no betumi akyerɛ faenu pɔtee bi din. Fa saa kwan no di dwuma ne bere a wontumi nhu asɛm a ɛfa ho no.
Wobɛtumi akyerɛw wɔn a wɔde wɔn nsa ayɛ nhwehwɛmu no ho nsonsonoe agu text log mu a ɛnkyerɛw wɔ dashboard no so. Nhyehyɛe a wɔde di dwuma a wɔatwa ho asɛm ato hɔ no nyɛ adanse a ɛkyerɛ sɛ nkrataa no apira.
GAME LOGS Fa di dwuma wɔ agyinatufoɔ a wɔapaw no no game log mu de hwɛ wiase-loading, configuration, mod, ne game-runtime mfomso. Ne tenabea gyina agodie no so, na ebetumi aba sɛ ɛwɔ fafa a wɔde asi hɔ no akyi.
KENKENKENKENKENKENKEN Hyɛ adwuma no ne bere no nsow, na afei hwehwɛ nsɛm a ɛfa nkoguo a edi kan a edi mũ no ho mu. Sɛ wɔtotow kwan wɔ awiei a, ebetumi ayɛ nsunsuanso sen sɛ ɛde bɛba.
Ansa na wode asɛm bi bɛka ho no, yi nsaaseɛ, tokens, webhooks, nkontaahyɛde, ne akwan a wofa so. Satisfactory'ankasa konsol/log no betumi anya administrator token. Kɔ so hwɛ wo ankasa nhwehwɛmu no ho.

3. Nkrataa ahodoɔ a etwa sɛ yɛhyehyɛ wɔ kasa ahodoɔ mu https://cepheusprotocol.wiki.gg/wiki/Dedicated_Servers

data.name: Content.72F10866249FA31A6B09
data.value:
Ɛbahola wɔagyinla server ne mɔɔ bɛkpa ye la azo. Paw ɔsomfo a ɛfata na hwɛ biribiara a ɛyɛ foforo ansa na woakɔ so.
1. Twe server no na yɛ mponto nnwinnade a wuhia. 2. Siesie backup adwuma a ɛwɔ Server Options mu no. 3. Paw nhyehyeɛ a wopɛ sɛ wode di dwuma no na hwɛ ne server, da, kɛse, ne ne nokorɛdie gyinabea. 4. Hwehwɛ mu hwɛ ansa na woasiesie no. Synix backup a ɛwɔ SHA-256 kwansideɛ mu no bɛtumi asane ɛne saa kwansideɛ no ahyia; tete nnwinnade nketewa betumi ayɛ agyapadeɛ. 5. Kenkan nsiakyibaa kɔkɔbɔ no na gye tom sɛ eyi ne ayaresabea a wopɛ. 6. Ma w'ahyehyɛe ne adwenemyɛ no wie a worenkyekyere Synix anaa worenkyekyere adekan. 7. Ma dwumadibea no mfi ase na hwɛ sɛ wɔasan wiase a ɛwɔ hɔ ne nneɛma a wɔasiesie no aba.
SƐN N'ASƐM A WƆHWƐ Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ de hu nsakrae ahorow a ɛfa nkontompo ho. Ɛnsɛ sɛ ɛma yehu sɛ wiase bi wɔ hɔ a na ɛyɛ den bere a wɔagye no nkwa anaa sɛ obi foforo de nhyehyeɛ bi a wɔde wɔn ho to so no yɛ nokware.
SƐ WƆKYERƐ ASƐM A WƆKYERƐ Kɔ so hwɛ nnwinnadewa ne adansedie anaa asesae nsɛm nkrataa biara. Kenkan asesae nkrabɔ no ansa na worebɔ mmɔden sɛ wobɛsan asiesie anaa wobɛyi nsɛmfua foforo afi hɔ.
Mfa ZIP mmfa nsisi dwuma a ɛrekɔ so. Sɛ agodie no kura savings wɔ fahodie a wɔde si hɔ no akyi a, fa agodie no siesie no faako a agodie no gyina so no.
Kɔ so hwɛ original backup no kɔsi sɛ woasɔ server a wɔasan de asi hɔ no ahwɛ ne Client connection.

data.name: Content.74448A2C2CBD821D56C4
data.value:
Deɛ Ɛwɔ hɔ Asisifoɔ no di nhyehyeɛ a wɔaboa so a ɛwɔ disk no so dedaw. Ɛnyɛ reinstall na ɛsono sɛ wɔde Synix transfer package a etwa to no bɛtɔ.
Ansa na Worebɛfa Yɛ backup soronko bi, a ɛfa savings biara a ɛwɔ installation folder no akyi. Twe server no na yi manager anaa scheduler foforo a obetumi adi dwuma bere a Synix redi dwuma no afiri.
Twerɛtohɔ Nkyerɛkyerɛmu 1. Paw Add Server → Import Existing Server. 2. Paw nkuraaseɛ a wɔde si hɔ no ankasa, na ɛnyɛ mmrɛaseɛ, ZIP file, anaa game-client folder. 3. Ma Synix nhwehwɛ no mu, na afei hwɛ sɛ woahunu agodie, edition, executable, ne asetena. 4. Fa din soronko bi ma krataafa no, na fa nneɛma a ɛresɛe no hyɛ mu. 5. Wie import no wie, bue Configure, na hwɛ ne kwan ne pon no. 6. Kɔ so yɛ Readyness, na afei yɛ controlled start baako. Hwɛ sɛ wiase ne nhyehyeɛ a wopɛ sɛ wode di dwuma no ayɛ adwuma anaa.
NEA ƐSƐ SƐ ƐSesa Nhoma a wɔde kyerɛwtohɔ yɛ no ntumi nsesa nhyehyeɛ no, ntena so bio, anaa nsiesie nsɛmma nhoma no ananmu. Akwan a wobɛpaw akyiri yi, te sɛ Update, Validate, anaa configuration repair, betumi asesa nkrataa.
Ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔhunu faako a wɔde hyɛ agyinatuo, modpacks, passwords, ne external saves automatically. Nhyehyɛe kwan koro no ara ntumi ntwerɛm mprenu.
SƐ WƆKYERƐ WƆN NNIPA Hwɛ sɛ woapaw adansifoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ adwuma no so a ɛboa profile a wɔpaw no. Mfa din foforo mmpa biribi a ɛho ntew mfa nhyɛ nsonsonoe. Kyerɛw agodie no ho amanneɛbɔ ne nkratafa a wɔayɛ ho kyerɛwtohɔ na ama wɔatumi ahwehwɛ ne nkyerɛase no mu.

data.name: Content.749F8256FE4490AB39C8
data.value:
Fa saa akwankyerɛ yi di dwuma bere a configuration editor no bɔ amanneɛ sɛ wɔagye field bi adi, nhyehyeɛ a ɛmfata, anaa template a ɛnsɔre.
HWƐ ASƐM A WOFI MU • Normal saving updates support values wɔ configuration a woapaw no mu. • Gyinae no si ɔhaw a wɔaka ho asɛm a ɛboa no so. • Aset resets restores template default and can remove custom settings.
Aseturo nyɛ ade a edi kan a ɛboa ma ɔsomfoɔ no di nkogu biara. Wɔremfa nkɔmmɔbɔ nkrataa no nsesa bere a wɔde di dwuma, ntomadan a wɔhyɛ mu, ne modifo a wɔakyekyɛ no nyɛ adwuma.
Ansa na wɔrebɛsiesie Ma w'ani nnyɛ adwuma no so, na hwɛ sɛ wo nsa nka nsɛm a wɔahyehyɛ no no bi, na kenkan nsakrae pɔtee a wɔayɛ ho nhyehyɛe no. Nhwɛsoɔ bi wɔ hɔ a wɔwɔ mfoni ahodoɔ; afoforo hwɛ kwan sɛ agodie no bɛtwetwe adansedi wɔ mfiase no anaa ɛbɛhia sɛ wɔde nsa si hɔ.
Synix bɔ amaneɛ sɛ agyiraehyɛde a ɛho hia no nni hɔ sen sɛ ɛbɛtumi asesa ɔfã biara wɔ kwan pa so. Sɛ wɔde template revision a wɔhwɛ so no di dwuma a, ɛbɛtumi agye .synix.before-template-v<revision>.bak din a ɛwɔ hɔ prɛko pɛ.
ASƐM A ƐDA SO Sɛ Obi Agye Biribi Anaa Ɔsiesie Biribi Kɔ so hwɛ backup anaa adesoa nkrataa biara na kenkan adesoa nkrataa no. Fa mfoni a wodii kan de yɛɛ adwuma no toto ho ansa na woapaw nea wode asiesie no ho. Mfa nsesa adanseɛ denam Reset a wobɛtumi ayɛ no mpɛn pii so.
Sɛ w'ani gye ho wie a, fi ase prɛko na hwɛ agokansie no ankasa. Hu sɛ ɛrekenkan kwan a ɛtene no na ɛho ntew a wohia no da so wɔ hɔ.

data.name: Content.7871EA5C906D13E02997
data.value:
Dune de mfiri a wɔde di dwuma wɔ amansan no mu a wɔde di dwuma no di dwuma wɔ wuram. Ɛnyɛ basabasa game server a edi dwuma baako.
ASƐM A ƐDA SO Kenkan Synix de nsiesie ho nsɛm a ɛhwɛ kwan ma system memory, AVX2, hardware virtualization, Hyper-V, ne Professional- anaa akyire no so Windows edition. Kae nneɛma a wohia no gyina ɔko kuw no ne nkrataa a wohwɛ so.
Synix mma virtualization anaa fa Hyper-V ntena hɔ komm. Di kan di agorɔ no ho dwuma ansa na woatumi adi dwuma.
ASƐM A ƐDA SO: 1. Yɛ Dune: Awakening entry na hwɛ ɛho ahiadeɛ ne fahodie folder no. 2. Kɔ so hwɛ na fa yɛ adwuma. 3. Synix di dwuma wɔ battlegroup.bat nnwinnadeɛ a wɔde di dwuma no mu, ɛne administrator prompt a ɛhia sɛ wɔde di dwuma no. 4. Paw initial-setup wɔ agodie no mu na fa wo Self-Host Token no ma. 5. Ma VM, wɛbsaet, ne akodi kuw a wɔasiesie no awie wɔ saa adeyɛ no mu.
Nya Self-Host Token no wɔ Funcom asɛm dwumadibea no so fa ne kwan/setup akwantu no so: https://account.duneawakening.com/
Kɔ so mfa mfatoho no nsie. Nkorɔnyɛ wɔ saa deɛ wɔde di dwuma yi ho nkyerɛ sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ Synix bedifoɔ biara di dwuma sɛ administrator.
ASƐM A ƐKYERƐ NA ASƐM A ƐKYERƐ Fa dwumadibea no ankasa host/VM network layout ne port a wɔhwehwɛ no di dwuma. Asɛmmisa nsɛm no mu metadata wɔ Synix gyina hɔ ma RMQ, na ɛnyɛ A2S nsɛm nsɛm asɛm no tiefo.
Ɔdehyeɛ a wɔato so no mfɛnsere nkyerɛ sɛ ne VM no agyae. Hu sɛnea wɔredi dwuma no ho nsɛm na fa di dwuma wɔ akodi kuw no mu wɔ agodie no dwumadi so.
Synix betumi asiesie, asesae, adi dwuma, na asiesie fahodie a wɔapaw no. Mma w'ani mmmere sɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ so wie, player queries, anaa watchdog retrieval no na ɛhwɛ akyi dwumadi no so koraa. Wɔmfa ntoasoɔ adansedeɛ no nni dwuma wɔ saa profile yi mu.
Fa game-supported shutdown ne backup nhyehyɛeɛ di dwuma ma VM/database data a ɛwɔ hɔ daa. Nhyehyɛɛ-fa-folder ZIP nko ara nyɛ ne backup a wɔadi ho adanseɛ.

data.name: Content.7B4987810DD3E78752A5
data.value:
Saa asɛmti yi yɛ ma wɔn a wɔatintim ne wɔn a wɔboa. Ɛnhia developer nnwinnade a wobɛtumi de adi dwuma de adi dwuma wɔ nhyiamu bi mu.
SƐN NA ASƐM ahorow yɛ adwuma Agodie nkyerɛkyerɛmu a wɔhyɛ mu no kyerɛkyerɛ downloads, executables, Steam AppIDs ne login ahwehwɛde, twintin akyinnyeɛ, pon, configuration behavior, prerequisites, ne controller tumi.
Nkyerɛkyerɛmu yi kyerɛ nsɛm a wɔde ato mu. Wɔmmfa nsɛm a wɔde di dwuma, nhyiamu, anaa nsaano nkyerɛwee a wɔato din no nhyɛ so. JSON adansedi krataafa a wɔde asi hɔ wɔ app folder no mu a, ɛnkeka game profile foforo a wɔahyehyɛ.
SƐ WƆKYERƐ ASƐM A WOBETUM A WOBETUM 1. Di kan kɔ official dedicated-server akwankyerɛ ne real generated configuration files mu. 2. Fa server-root-relative paths di dwuma wɔ baabi a ɛho hia ne game-facing identifiers pɛpɛɛpɛ. 3. Fa mfoni a wɔhyɛ mu ma wɔ baabi a wɔahyehyɛ no pɛpɛɛpɛ. 4. Ma nteaseɛ/ahyehyɛde/sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛtumi ayɛ nsakrae wɔ nkyerɛase no mu. 5. Fa nhomawa no di dwuma, fa SDK a adwuma no hwehwɛ no si hɔ, na yɛ nhwehwɛmu a ɛfa ho. 6. Nhwehwɛmu fafa, fiase, gyae, ne nsɛm a wɔde di dwuma wɔ agodie ankasa mu ansa na w'akyerɛkyerɛ mu.
Nkyerɛkyerɛmu Ɔbenfo no yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛbɛyɛ de asiesie adwadie, na ɛnyɛ mmrɛdeɛ a w'ayɛ de asiesie.
NNIPA a WƆDE HWƐ ASƐM • UI: Nkekaho mfɛnsere. • ServerHandler: Game controllers ne server integrations. • SynixEngine: Application lifecycle, maintenance, networking, backups, ne security. • Nhyehyɛe: Wɔde nnwinnade a wɔde di dwuma, nsɛmti, ne nneɛma a wɔboa ma wɔhyehyɛ. • Database/GameDefinitions: Game profile ne template. • Database/ModSystems: Adwumayɛ adesuadeɛ a wɔboa. • Beae a wɔhyehyɛ: Interface catalogs ne generator. • Nhwehwɛmu: Nhwehwɛmu a ɛfa su ahorow ho.
Sɛ wopɛ nkyerɛaseɛ a, ma kasa biara nni hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ wohyehyɛ mu na hwɛ baabi a wobɛkɔ. Fa mmoa ho nsɛm, nhwehwɛmu, nkɔmmɔbɔ ho asɛm, ne agodie a ɛbɛboa no ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu ka ho. Mma nkyerɛw ntumu, nsafeɛ, tokens, user values, anaa output-recognition markers ase. Asuahu ho kyerɛwtohɔ a edi kan no nsesae.
Kenkan License & Proprietary Terms ansa na wobɛsan atrɛw code anaa w'adwuma ase. Kɔ so mfa nhyehyɛeɛ a edi mu ne nkrataa a wɔde di dwuma no nsie nkrataa ne nkrataa ahorow.
