data.name: Content.7C1660167D3419DD05A4
data.value:
Hwɛ sɛ wobɛtumi asiesie kɔmputa dwumadie no ho nhyehyɛe bere a woasɔ backup, update, stop, ne start behavior no ahwɛ.
1. Bue n'awotomatiki/ahyehyɛde ahyehyɛde no na fa nhyehyɛe no yɛ adwuma. 2. Paw nna ne bere. 3. Ma Smart Maintenance nyɛ adwuma na paw backup/update options a ɛwɔ hɔ no. 4. Si gyinae sɛ woretwɛn ahwɛfo no anaasɛ worentwɛn no, na fa bere a wobegye akyinnye no si hɔ. 5. Kɔ so hwɛ na hwɛ wɔ ahobammɔ pon a wubetumi ahwɛ so.
Nkrataa a wɔde di dwuma no fa kɔmputa bere so. Ma ne dɔnhwerew ne ne bere mu nsɛso nyɛ papa.
BƐN NA ASƐM A ƐDA SO Synix bɛtumi atwɛn ama wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho akyekyere, na afei de adi dwuma de asiesie nhyehyɛeɛ kuw a wɔadi ho adanse no gyinaeɛ, backup berɛ a wɔasiesie, de asiesie, ne reset ase sɛdeɛ wɔpaw no.
Bere dodow a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔtwentwɛn wɔn nan ase no yɛ hyeɛ, ɛnyɛ bɔ sɛ wɔbɛtwɛn afebɔɔ. Sɛ agyinatufoɔ no tena hɔ mpo a, wobetumi akɔ so atete wɔn ho wɔ bere a ɛtwa toɔ no. Sɛ wɔtwentwɛn wɔn nan ase a, wontumi ntwɛn.
NNIPA A WƆN HO NKYERƐKYERƐ NNIPA A WƆN HO NKYERƐKYERƐ Ɛtwɛn gyina nimdeɛ a agodie a wɔapaw no betumi de ama no so. API-kyekyere Satisfactory adwumayɛfoɔ di agyinatuo anaa nni hɔ a wɔtumi de di dwuma yie wɔ berɛ a wɔasiesie no sɛ wɔretwɛn no. Ɛhye ɛmmaa bɛngola bɛngola bɛnlie bɛndo nu.
Bɔ mmɔden ka ho asɛm kyerɛ agyinatufo no ansa na woakenkan dwumadi no ho nsɛm. Discord amanneɛbɔ ahodoɔ no bɛtumi adi dwuma wɔ berɛ a wɔahyehyɛ wɔn akwantuo no mu.
Ɛsɛ sɛ PC no te ase na ɛsɛ sɛ Synix nhyehyɛeɛ anaa nhyehyeɛ a ɛfa akyi no di dwuma. Kɔmputa bi a wɔagyae adwuma anaa ɔda hɔ no ntumi nyɛ nneɛma a wɔhyehyɛ ho nhyehyɛe a wobɛtumi atwe na asan afi ase.

data.value:
Bue Windows Terminal anaa PowerShell na fa bɔborɔ identifier a ɛwɔ ase ha no. Saa ahyɛde yi na ɛhwɛ Synix no ankasa so, na ɛnyɛ game servers biara.
TETEƐ winget install --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
CHECK THE INSTALLED PACKAGE winget list --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
ASƐM foforo Fa Synix to w'ani so na wie n'adwuma ansa na wode: winget upgrade --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
YƐKYERƐ ASƐM no winget uninstall --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
HWƐ W'ADWENE Adwumayɛfoɔ dwumadie, savings, ne backup yɛ soronko firi application package no mu. Mma wo mmfa C:\Synix anaa adansedi nkrataa nkrataa nkrataa biara nsesa gye sɛ wopɛ sɛ wonsesa saa nkrataa no.
SƐ ASƐM bi nni mu Kenkan nea enti a wɔkae no. Sɛ WinGet bɔ amanneɛ sɛ ɔhyehyɛfoɔ hash nhyia a, gyae na bɔ ho amanneɛ; mmfa hash verification mmfa mmfa mmma ho. Sɛ wɔannya ntoasoɔ a, ebetumi akyerɛ sɛ adansibea no nnya nnhyehyɛ nkrataa foforo bi.
WinGet nhyehyɛeɛ ne nsɛm a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wobɛde ahwehwɛde hash no mfa code-sign Synix na ɛnhyɛ sɛ Windows ahobammɔ software no bɛdie no di.

data.name: Content.89E9CF0E65B8EACE25DF
data.value:
Ɛsɛ sɛ wohu sɛ ɔkyena no yɛ adwuma wɔ wo nea ɛto so abiɛsa. Router a ɛdi kan no, ɛmfa ho sɛ wobegye nea ɛto so abiɛsa no.
SUKƆ ADWOM A ƐSƐ ADESUA NO • Wɔ server PC so: Fa nea wɔfrɛ no local anaa loopback connection. • Wɔ home-network foforo mu: Fa server PC's LAN address. • Wɔ home network no mu: Fa wo honam adrɛs anaa ɔkyena a emu yɛ den discovery/join method.
bue Connection Information ma entry a w'ayi no sɛ wobɛhwɛ ne endpoints. Private LAN address ntumi mfa nni dwuma amonom hɔ ara wɔ internet players so.
TEST LOCALLY 1. Woyii akyɛde no so. 2. Nkwampaefo 3. Yare no wɔ hostom PC mu, na ɛto so abiɛsa wɔ LAN no mu. 4. Sɛ LAN abɛfa so a, hwɛ abɛfa so ne Windows Firewall abɛfa so na wobehu sɛ ɛhe na ɛyɛ server executable.
ADWUMA INTERNET PLAYERS 1. Dwe hostom no stable LAN adrɛs, a ɛte sɛ ne router DHCP reservation. 2. Hunu ports a wohia ne TCP/UDP protocols ma game configuration ankasa no. 3. Fa so a ɛto so abiɛsa no na fa so wɔ host's LAN address. 4. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔma nea ɛto so a ɛtete nea ɛto so no rekɔ Windows Firewall wɔ netewtale profiles a woreyɛ. 5. Sɛdeɛ yɛbɛhwɛ no, yɛfrɛ intanɛt ho nhyehyɛe soronko bi so.
Ntumi mfa DMZ, mma firewall no nyɛ adwuma, anaa mma ammirikatu port biara nyɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so siesie. Ma wo router nkrataa no nyɛ kokoam.
Synix ne lokal desktop manager. Ɛmfa ho hwee panel anaa public relay a ɛbɛma nea ɛto so abiɛsa yi anwu.

data.name: Content.8B70E3569A9351B28D08
data.value:
SteamCMD twe mpuntuo a ɛwɔ server no so de di dwuma wɔ Steam agodie a wɔde di dwuma no ho. Synix yɛ n'ahyehyɛde copy automatically; Ɔdwumadifoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛtete saa no nhyehyeɛ biara nni ho SteamCMD akatua.
DI ASƐM A ƐDA SO Paw ɔsomfoɔ no na kenkan Activity & Diagnostics. Akwankyerɛ paneɛ animation kyerɛ sɛ wɔresisi adwuma no. SteamCMD betumi asesa afiri downloading, allocating, unpacking, ne validation ntam, enti n'afiri nyɛ daa na ɛma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu a ɛwɔ hɔ anaa bere a wɔde di dwuma a aka.
Ma disk adwuma no wie bere a network akwantu no kɔ fam mpo. Kenkan nkontaabu a etwa to no ansa na woakɔyɛ adwuma foforo.
TETE W'AWƆN NSA Open Settings → General → SteamCMD Download Speed. Paw mode a ɛboro so a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran no na hyɛ mu ntenten a wɔahyɛ ho dwuma no, anaa paw tumi nyinaa.
Eyi ka SteamCMD a wobɛtumi atwe, ɛnyɛ nnipakuw no bandwidth, agodie biara a ɛnnyɛ Steam downloader, anaa akwantu nyinaa wɔ PC no so.
ASƐM A ƐDA SO NSƐM A ƐDA SO Agodie nhyiamu bi hwehwɛ Steam twerɛtohɔ krataa ne Steam Guard nkyerɛkyerɛ. fa Synix de login prompt no di dwuma; mmfa nhyehyɛeɛ nkyerɛkyerɛmu nsɛm wɔ nhyehyɛeɛmu anaa amanneɛbɔ ahorow mu.
Sɛ wo nsa nnim sɛ wobɛtumi atwe bi a, kenkan SteamCMD mfomso no pɛpɛɛpɛ na hwɛ disk aporɔ, folda kwan, network kwan, ne akontaa ho ahiade biara. Nhomakorabea a wɔde di dwuma no betumi atwe mpuntuo a wɔde di dwuma no so, enti hwɛ sɛ wobɛyɛ nsakrae a wɔasiesie ansa na wode adi dwuma.

data.name: Content.9C3A77D42EDA0BF1010D
data.value:
Empyrion nsɛm tebea ne server-code mods yɛ soronko. Wɔ Server Options → Mod & Plugin Manager mu no, paw Empyrion scenarios anaa Empyrion server mods. Ma server no nnyɛ adwuma na hwɛ sɛ wobɛtumi ayɛ nsakrae biara ansa na woadi backup.
FA SENARIO bi si hɔ 1. Browse Catalog buee Steam Adwumam. Yɛ wo ho hyehyeɛ ma asɛm no na twɛn sɛ Steam bɛwie n'adesoa. Adwumam mfoni ne nhyehyeɛ nyɛ server nsɛm tebea. 2. Paw Nhyehyɛe a Wode Bɛfa Aba no, na afei paw Folder. Paw nsɛm tebea nketewa nkrataa a ɛwɔ wo Steam nhomakorabea steamapps\workshop\content\383120 nkrataa no mu. Wobɛtumi nso apaw nsɛm tebea a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ZIP. 3. Fa nsɛm tebea a wonim no folda din hyɛ mu. Mma Workshop ID no nko ara na fa di dwuma. Kɔ so hwɛ fafa din koro no ara ma nsɛm foforo a ɛbɛba daakye. 4. Hwɛ nkuraaseɛ ne baabi a wɔrekɔ kɔhwɛ, na afei hwɛ sɛ wɔde akɔfa. Synix twe nsɛm asekyerɛ no nyinaa kɔ Content\Scenarios mu a ɛnkanyan no anaa ɛnsesa wiase biara. 5. Paw Scenario nsɛm a wɔde asi hɔ. Paw biako na hwɛ din a wɔde asie no. Sɛ obi sesa kɔ tebea foforɔ mu a, ɛhia sɛ ɔde din foforɔ a ɛnnyɛ adwuma di dwuma; Synix ma yɛhu sɛ obi wɔ hɔ, na ɛma nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ da so wɔ hɔ. 6. Fa nhyiamu no di dwuma, bɔ server no ho ban, na hwɛ ne log ne obi a ɔde ne ho adi dwuma no. Nsɛm tebea bi wɔ hɔ a wɔn kyerɛwfo akyerɛw emu nsɛm anaa ɛho ahiade foforo.
Scenario din yɛ GameConfig.CustomScenario; Wiase a wɔagye no din yɛ GameConfig.GameName. Synix di backup wɔ dedicated.yaml ansa na ɛresesa saa nsase yi na ɛma server entry no di dwuma. Ɛmfa nsoromma, nsaano nkyerɛwee, anaa nneɛma a ɛne no nhyia no nsi hɔ bio.
FA SERVER MOSS si hɔ Fa Empyrion server mods profile ne Import Package di dwuma de paw mod ZIP anaa mod folder a woahyehyɛ no. Fa ne DLL, ademude a ɛboa, gyinapɛn, ne _Info.yaml ka ho bere a wɔde ama no. Synix fa saa nneɛma yi hyɛ Content\Mods ase; bere a game no fii ase no, na wɔde code no hyɛ mu. Nkyerɛkyerɛmu mpɔnkyerɛmu a edidi so yi na edidi so a wɔhyehyɛ no nyɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔgye toom.
Synix mmfa mod loader nto hɔ anaasɛ mmfa mod a ɛmma adwuma no nyɛ adwuma prɛko pɛ. Di ɔtwerɛfoɔ no ahiadeɛ so, a ɛka loader, configuration, ne client setup biara ho. Nhwehwɛmu a edi mu a wɔde di dwuma no nkyerɛ sɛ mod bi ne bɔn a wɔdi dwuma mprempren anaa modifo foforo a wɔde ato hɔ no hyia.
ASƐM A ƐDA SO NE AFOTUSƐM Steam twe ne Workshop copy, na ɛnyɛ server copy a Synix twe no. Sɛ wobɛtumi asesa a, to ɛserɛ no gyina na fa nsɛm a wɔasesa no di dwuma de fa asɛmfua foforo din koro no ara di dwuma. Hwehwɛ mu hu sɛ ɔkyerɛwfo no hia agyigye foforo anaa. Nkyerɛkyerɛmu a wɔasiesie no nya mpɛsɛmpɛsɛm; update a wɔde di dwuma no nyɛ ade a ɛho ntew a wɔsan de si hɔ bio, na ɛnkeka nsɛm a enni hɔ wɔ nkrataa foforo no mu.
Nkrataa ahodoɔ a etwa sɛ yɛhyehyɛ no, ɛnyɛ nkrataa ahodoɔ a etwa sɛ yɛhyehyɛ no nyinaa. Ɔhyehyɛ (ntene so) kyerɛ sɛ wɔde import no adi dwuma, ɛnkyerɛ sɛ wɔasan ahwehwɛ faako a wɔahyehyɛ no nyinaa mu bio. Roll Back Import no twe import a wɔapaw no nyinaa, a ɛka modifo foforo a wɔwɔ paneɛ koro no ara mu ho, na ɛmpene sɛ wɔde faenu ahodoɔ a asesa wɔ Synix akyi no besi ananmu. Akwan a wɔpaw no ne nsɛm tebea a ɛho hia wiase ahorow a wɔagye wɔn nkwa no bɔ ho ban fi nsonsonoe ho; sɛ wɔrekyerɛw nsɛm tebea foforo a, ɛbɛtumi asan akɔ ne kan nsɛmma nhoma no mu.

data.name: Content.9CA409AF86EBA5BEC5C1
data.value:
Open Configure → Network & RCON na woahwehwɛ nsɛm a wɔde di dwuma wɔ agodie a wapaw no mu. Fa sɛnea agodie no te ankasa no di dwuma, na ɛnyɛ port ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ no.
Nkyɛm a wɔhwɛ kwan so • Game port: Player akwantu. • Asɛmmisa pon: Server asɛm anaa nsɛm a ɛbɛyɛ sɛ wobɛhwɛ nsɛm no. • RCON/admin port: Nhyehyɛmu ho nhyehyeɛ kwan. • App/API port: Agokansie anaa adwadie dwumadie a ɛfa agodie ho.
TCP ne UDP yɛ akwankyerɛ soronko. Nhyehyɛmu ahodoɔ mmienu betumi de port nomoro koro no ara adi dwuma, nanso nkomafoɔ mmienu ntumi mmɔ nsie a ɛgyina hɔ wɔ tieyɛ ano. Synix nso di nhyehyeɛ a wɔakora so no ho adanseɛ de kyerɛ sɛ nsonsonoeɛ wɔ port mu, a emu nso ne nhyehyeɛ a wɔagyae.
Kɔ so hwɛ kwan ma endpoints no yɛ soronko wɔ tebea horow a ɛyɛ soronko mu, na nya abusuabɔ biara a ehia wɔ agyinatuo no ntam. Mfa no sɛ gameplay nyinaa yɛ UDP anaa sɛ asɛmmisa biara fa tiefo ankasa ho.
ADMISTRATION Nnyɛ agodie Wɔn a wɔdi agorɔ no nhia RCON anaa dwumadibea foforo biara. Kɔ so hwɛ sɛ w'akwantu no wɔ hɔ kɔsi sɛ wowɔ akyirikyiri akwantu ho nhyehyɛe pɔtee bi.
ASƐM A ƐKYERƐKYERƐ NA ASƐM • Minecraft Java ne Bedrock de nkitahodi soronko di dwuma; di nhyiamu a wɔapaw no akyi. • Satisfactory's local API di dwuma wɔ ne configured game/API port mu; no legacy query field value is no extra requirement for Synix. • Dune no mmisa-bea metadata gyina hɔ ma ne RMQ dwumadi pon, na ɛnnyɛ obiara Steam A2S mmisa adwuma. • Rust+ de n'ankasa mfitiaseɛ a ɛka ne ho no di dwuma wɔ gameplay akyi.
Template default yɛ start values, ɛnyɛ universal router-opening checklist. Hwehwɛ tiefo ankasa no mu ansa na woasesa firewall mmara.

data.value: Dune: Awakening di dwuma wɔ adansedifoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ adwuma no ho. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde Hyper-V ne hardware virtualization di dwuma, na ɛhia sɛ wɔfa Windows Pro anaa Enterprise. Wɔ prɛko no, Synix bɔ battlegroup.bat ase sɛ Administrator. Paw initial-setup na ma wo Self-Host Token no nsiesie. Synix betumi atoto, asiesie, asiesie, na adi dwuma no, nanso agodie no yɛ kɔmputa mfiri ne wɔn dwumadi tebea no wura. Nkyerɛkyerɛmu wɔ Twi mu: https://duneawakening.com/en/news/dedicated-server-how-to-guide

data.name: Content.A2B1D27FE31D2DC1D587
data.value:
Discord webhooks twe server dwumadie a wɔapaw no kɔ channel bi so. Wɔyɛ amanneɛbɔ, na ɛnyɛ Discord bot a wɔde twe akyirikyiri hwɛ Synix.
Hyɛ baabi a wobɛkɔ 1. Bue anaa nya webhook ma dwumadibea a w'apene so sɛ wobɛhwɛ. 2. Bue server a wɔapaw no no de Configure → Discord kratafa. 3. Kɔ webhook no mu na paw nsɛm a ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛde dwumadi ba. 4. Kɔ so hwɛ nhyehyeɛ no so. 5. Fa asɔduro bi di dwuma, sɛ wɔama ho kwan a, anaa hyɛ bɔ sɛ wobɛma no wɔ nhyehyɛe mu.
Ahyehyɛde a ɛfa start, shutdown, recovery, backup, ne maintenance ho gyina ɔkwan a wɔde di dwuma no so na sɛ adwuma no aba ankasa anaa.
Bɔ URL no Ho Ban Webhook URL bi wɔ nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde to gua. Obiara a obenya no betumi de nkra agu saa kwan no so. Twe wo ho fi screenshots, nsɛm, kyerɛwtohɔ, ne nkɔmmɔbɔ ho.
Synix bɔ webhook a wɔakora so no ho ban ma Windows difoɔ. Sɛ URL no da adi a, twɛn anaa yi no wɔ Discord mu, na afei ma Synix kwan so. Hwɛ nkuraho din ne dwumadi ho nsɛm a wɔde kɔ aguadibea a wɔakyekyɛ no so.
SƐ N'AFOTUSƐM RENYA Hwehwɛ dwumadi no kwan a woapaw, URL no, channel/webhook a ɛwɔ hɔ, ne sɛ PC no betumi akɔ Discord anaa. Hwehwɛ mfomso a wɔahyɛ ho amanneɛ no mu a wonnhyɛ URL no nyinaa adi.
Nkrataa ahodoɔ a etwa sɛ yɛhyehyɛ wɔ kasa ahodoɔ mu Discord. Ɛnsɛ sɛ wobue input router control port.

data.name: Content.AC2F6ED0F16118E96232
data.value:
Si gyinae sɛ worebɛyi control panel nko ara afi hɔ anaasɛ wobɛyi wo hosted servers no nso afi hɔ afebɔɔ. Eyinom yɛ nnwuma a ɛsono sɛnea obiara di dwuma.
YƐKYƐ ASƐM no nko na yi 1. Siesie kɔmputa biara a ɛwɔ hɔ, fa no kɔ baabi foforo, anaa fa backup no si hɔ. 2. Ma w'asomdoma mfa Synix nkɔ, twɛn sɛ wɔbɛwie adansi, na fi Synix kɔ. 3. Fa wiase a ɛho hia, nhyehyɛe nsɛmma nhoma, ne nkrataa ahorow no bi sie. 4. Yi Synix firi Windows Apɛde a wode asi hɔ anaa wo package manager no so.
Fa C:\Synix, custom server folders, external game saves, ne backup locations sie sɛ wopɛ sɛ wosan de di dwuma. Sɛ wobɛsan de app no asi hɔ a, ɛrenhia sɛ wotwa nkrataa yi.
YƐKYƐ SERVER baako INTRY Fa di dwuma wɔ server a woapaw no no mu de Delete adwuma no di dwuma wɔ Synix na kenkan nkwankyerɛ no. Sɛ woyi paneɛ no so asɛm bi fi hɔ a, ɛnkyerɛ sɛ woregye atom sɛ wobɛpopa faenu faenu anaa backup. Hu nsɛm a wɔbɛyi afi hɔ no mu pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Mfa bɛkyɛw nyɛ nkekaeɛ a wɔde siesie ɔhaw. Nsakrae a wɔde sie wɔ adaka a woreyi no mu nko ara na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛnnyɛ asesae nkyerɛwee.
Sɛ worebɛsan akɔ paneɛ foforo so a, hwɛ sɛ ɛbɛtumi ama woasiesie no yie na woahyehyɛ wiase a wopɛ ansa na woreyi w'asɛmpa dedaw no afi hɔ.

Paw asɛm bi wɔ benkum hɔ na kenkan ɛho akwankyerɛ. Mmoa nkrataa nyinaa di dwuma wɔ offline wɔ kasa a woapaw no mu.
SYNIX ho nsɛm foforo? Ma w'ani nhyehyɛeɛ a edi kan wɔ Getting Started & Setup mu.
SƐ WƆDE SERVER di dwuma a, dɛn na wobɛyɛ? Paw adwuma no ho nhyehyeɛ, te sɛ nhyehyeɛ, networking, backup, anaa game-specific control.
Worehwehwɛ mfomso bi? Hyɛ Ctrl+F so na hwehwɛ dwumadi, agodie, anaa nkakrankakra wɔ asɛm no mu. Nhwehwɛmu hwehwɛ asɛmti ti ne emu nsɛm nyinaa, na ɛma nsɛm a ɛtete saa pue.
Fa nhwehwɛ kratafa no so san kɔ adesua nyinaa mu. Twe ne mmoa nkitahodi a wobɛtumi abue wɔ wo browser mu bere a woapaw wɔn no nko ara.

data.name: Content.B9AD3A6BF122B35896B1
data.value:
Paw server na fa ne connexion-test anaa player nnwinnadeɛ no di dwuma berɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ. Synix di nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛsɛ sɛnea game's supported query, TCP/UDP/HTTP, local API, ne process capabilities te.
ASƐM A ƐDA SO Ɛkwan a wɔfa so di dwuma wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a enni nnyinasoɔ mu no nkyerɛ sɛ obi betumi de ne ho adi dwuma na ɔde ne ho adi dwuma. Bio nso, nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ hɔ no nkyerɛ sɛ ne nhwehwɛmu adwuma no ayɛ krado.
Agodifo dodow ne agodifo din yɛ ade a ɛyɛ soronko. Server bi betumi akyerɛ sɛnea nnipa dodow a wɔakyekyɛ wɔn ho no bere a ɛnkyerɛw kuw bi din. Nhyehyɛe a enni hɔ nyɛ nnipakan a wɔagye atom.
HIDDEN TOOLS OR N/A EOS nkutoo anaa crosssplay mode bi ntumi mma obi nhyehyɛe mmisa anaa player-management channel. Synix betumi akyerɛ N/A anaa agyinatuo afiri sɔhwɛ mu de agye adi sɛ ɛbɛdaadaa nsunsuansoɔ.
Hwɛ edition a wɔapaw no ne adesoa a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Minecraft ho. Satisfactory player counts gyina ne local API connection so. Nnya EOS nkyerɛkyerɛ a edwumadiefo nkutoo de hyɛ sɔhwɛ bi mu.
SERVER-BROWSER LISTINGS Steam agodie pii de A2S nsɛmmisa di dwuma, nanso eyi nyɛ wiase nyinaa. Nhoma a wɔde kyerɛwtohɔ, agodibea a wɔde di agorɔ, ne kɔmputa so nhwehwɛmu adwuma no ma obiara hu ade, na bere biara nni hɔ a wɔhyɛ ho bɔ.
Sɛ ɔsomfoɔ bi nni hɔ wɔ kɔmputa nhwehwɛmufo bi mu a, sɔ agodie no ho kwan a wɔde fa nkitaho tẽẽ no hwɛ na hwɛ ne kyerɛwtohɔ. Sɛ wɔsesa nsɛm a ɛmfa asɛmmisa no ho mpɛn pii a, ebetumi de ɔhaw foforo aba.

data.name: Content.BDCE626AE85DA5ADC9CD
data.value:
Fa Configure di dwuma ma nkorɔfo a wɔtaa di dwuma wɔ Synix mu. Fa configuration-file editor no di dwuma wɔ Server Options mu bere a ɛsɛ sɛ wohwɛ anaa wosesa agodie no configuration ankasa no.
1. Sɛ ɛkenkan adansedi no bere a ɛreyɛ adwuma anaa sɛ ɛrekyerɛw no foforo a, twe dwuma no. 2. Yɛ backup na gye server ne file a woapaw no tom. 3. Kenkan nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ ne ɛho nsɛnkyerɛne. 4. Sesa nneɛma a wopɛ sɛ wosesa no nkutoo. 5. Siesie kyerɛwfo no nkontompo ahorow a wɔde di dwuma no, na hwɛ kɔkɔbɔ ahorow a ɔde ma no so. 6. Kɔ so hwɛ, fa Synix di dwuma, na hwɛ game log a etwa to no.
Nkyerɛkyerɛmu ahodoɔ a edidi soɔ yi Synix de fomate-nim dwuma a wɔde di dwuma ma INI/sɛdeɛ wɔhyɛ aseɛ, JSON, XML, YAML, ne profile-specific formats afoforo. Ɛnyɛ nkrataa anaa nhyehyeɛ biara na ɛwɔ editor a wɔde di dwuma. YAML editing boa nhyiamu a wɔakyekyere, nsɛm a wɔakyekyere, ne nsɛm a ɛwɔ ɔfã baako mu bere a wɔakora nsɛm ne nsɛm no so. YAML ho nneɛma a ɛyɛ den te sɛ ankora, abodin, inline collection, ne multiline values no, wɔmpɛ sɛ wɔde sie.
Kɔ so hwɛ configuration keys, values a wogye tom, map din, ne akwankyerɛ no pɛpɛɛpɛ sɛnea agodie no hwɛ kwan sɛ wɔbɛyɛ. Nkyerɛ wɔn ase nkɔ kasa a wɔde di dwuma no mu.
ASƐM A ƐKYERƐ SƐ WƆBƐHWƐ Nhoma a wɔayɛ no yie no betumi ama nneɛma a ɛne no nhyia akɔ so. Mods anaa game updates betumi de nneɛma bi aba a editor no nnim ho. Hwɛ sɛ agodie no de fafa ne wiase a wɔabɔ ho ban no ahyɛ mu.
Sɛ ɔtwerɛfo foforo anaa agodie no sesa twerɛtohɔ no bere a ɛda hɔ no a, to no so bio na fa toto ho ansa na w'akora. Agodie files betumi ayɛ kratafa anaa tokens a wobetumi akenkan; hwehwɛ mu na twe ho ansa na wode adi dwuma.
Satisfactory's live API options wɔ ne Control Center mu na ɛyɛ soronko wɔ editing wɔ disk so configuration files no ho.

data.name: Content.C3732C45553C69AA02C1
data.value:
Paw Configure for an existing server, anaa fa setup window no di dwuma bere a worebɔ bi. Sesa nsase a ɛfa w'adwumam nkutoo.
ASƐM A Mfiaseɛ NE ASƐM A ƐDA SO Adesuadeɛ a ɛdi kan no hyɛ asetena mu nhyehyeɛ ne ahyɛdeɛ a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran a wɔde firi. Ɔkwan a ɛkɔ anim no ma yɛhu nnwinnade foforo a wɔde di dwuma, a ebi ne mmoa wɔ RCON ne nnwinnadeɛ a wɔde hyɛ agyinatuo mu. Akwan a wɔsesa no mfa nsesaw a wɔakora so. Discord amanneɛbɔ wɔ akwan mmienu biara so.
NEA ƐKYERƐ WƆN Nkrataa Nhoma Nyinaa • Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Servers din, game, edition/version, ne gameplay-profile gyinaesi ahorow a wɔboa. • Ahɔhoɔ: Nkrataa ahodoɔ ne nhyehyeɛ afoforɔ a wɔde di dwuma a ɛwɔ template no mu. • Wiase Awo ntoatoaso: Wiase din, aba, kɛse, ne wiase ahorow a wɔde di dwuma. • Network & RCON: Gameplay, query, companion/API, ne administrative endpoints a wɔboa. • Automation: Backup/update-on-start ne berɛ a wɔahyehyɛ ɛhwɛ so. • Discord: Amanneɛbɔ nnuaba ne dwumadie a wɔde di dwuma. • Install & Launch: Ɔdehyeɛ nkrataa ne dehyeɛ mmrɛsodeɛ a ɛboa.
Agodibea a wɔasiesie ama agodie no yɛ atirimpɔw. Agodie bi betumi ayɛ ne ho anaa enhia mmoa; sɛ wɔde akyinnyegye pii hyɛ ɔsahene no mu a, ɛrenyɛ adepa.
ASƐM NNA A WƆKYERƐ Adwumayɛfoɔ ho nsɛm → Asetena a ɛhia → Nhwɛsoɔ → Adwumayɛfoɔ ho nsɛm
Nkyerɛkyerɛmu yi kyerɛ aseɛ sɛ wɔasiesie no, na ɛnyɛ download anaa installation progress. Sɛ nkontaahɔdeɛ a wɔhwehwɛ no tu ansa a, Synix bue ɛkwan 3 sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛtumi asesa w'anwanwadeɛ no, na afei abue Save Server. Nsakrae gyinabea a ɛkyekyere Adwinnwen bio kosi sɛ wɔbɛkyerɛ nsesae ahodoɔ no wɔ Review mu. Ɛsɛ sɛ w'ani gye ho sɛ wobegye wo ho nkwa; mmuaeɛ a ɛbue Review ntumi nnye automatically. Kenkan asɛm a ɛwɔ ase hɔ ankasa bere a biribi ho hia atenka.
Sɛ worehyehyɛ kɔmputa so dwumadibea bi a, hwɛ sɛ nsakrae no bɛka adfaahodie anaa nhyiamu a wɔkenkan no bere a wɔrebɔ ho ban no a, gyae. Save Changes yɛ ne nhyehyeɛ; ɛnhyɛ bɔ sɛ agodie bi a ɛreyɛ no de saa gyinapɛn ahorow yi adi dwuma. Fa Synix di dwuma foforo bere a agodie no hwehwɛ no.

data.name: Content.CBFC11B8C03869110CF7
data.value:
Open Configure → Automation ma server a wɔapaw no no paw adwuma a ɛrekɔ so ansa na wɔde adi dwuma.
Mfiaseɛ a Ɛsan Fi Aseɛ Ma eyi nyɛ adwuma na ama woatumi ayɛ backup a wɔasi gyina hɔ ma adwumayɛfoɔ ansa na wɔde adi dwuma. Fa backup root ne retention di dwuma wɔ application Settings → Backups mu.
Ɔhaw a ɛsan ba no fi ase de atirimpɔw bi a ɛne sɛ wobegyae backup adwuma a wɔyɛ no daa no. Automatic startup backups nyɛ adeɛ a ɛgyina hɔ ma nnwontoɔ a ɛnnyɛ adwuma ansa na nsakrae akɛseɛ aba.
ASƐM A ƐDA SO NSƐM A ƐDA SO Ma eyi nyɛ adwuma na ama w'ayɛ game update check a wɔaboa ma ansa na woayi no adi. Ɛma game-server nkrataa so, ɛnyɛ Synix app no.
Nsakrae ho nhwehwɛmu nyɛ bɔhyɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ bere biara a wofi ase no wohyew nkrataa. SteamCMD ne agodie no siesiefo no si gyinae sɛ dɛn na ɛho hia.
ASƐM A ƐDA SO NA ASƐM A ƐDA SO Gyinae a wɔde nsa de di dwuma wɔ validate mu betumi asiesie anaa asan atwe mpopoe a installer no di dwuma no so. Nkyerɛkyerɛmu ahodoɔ a edidi so yi ansa na wɔatintim anaa wɔama ho kwan; mmfa nnhyɛ w'adwumayɛ ho nkrataa no so bere nyinaa.
SƆ W'AFOTUSƐM Kɔ so hwɛ nneɛma a wobɛtumi de adi dwuma no so na di kan fi ase. Kenkan dwumadi no nsunsuanso na woatumi de backup, asesa, na adi dwuma. Sɛ wowie a, ɛnkyerɛ sɛ agodie no ayɛ adwuma yiye.
Ma baabi a ɛfata nyɛ hɔ mma archives, downloads, temporary files, ne game a wɔde asi hɔ no. Sɛ adwuma a edi kan no ka sɛ biribi ayɛ yie a, hwehwɛ nea enti a wɔkaa ho asɛm no mu sen sɛ wobetu server koro no ara afi Synix hɔ akɔho.

data.value:
Bue Readiness ma serwer a wapaw no ansa na w'afi ase anaa bere a biribi ankɔ yiye. Ɛka nhwehwɛmu a ɛkyerɛ sɛ saa profile yi boa, te sɛ files, runtimes, configuration, disk space, ports, process state, ne relevant logs.
ƆWƐN-ABAN NEA ƐSƐ ADESUA NO • Ready: Wobegye no adi sɛ, ɛno na ɛho hia paa. • Review: Ka nea ɛto so abiɛsa no ho asɛm na wobenya ahotoso sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ woyɛ biribi. • Blocked: Wobekum nea ɛto so abiɛsa no ansa na wudi kan.
Readiness ntumi nhyɛ nea ɛto so biara mu. Nkwampaefo a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ ne n’asɛm.
ƐFƆ SƐ W’ANYƐ ADESUA A ƐSƐ ADESUA A WƆDE NO Nneɛma a ɛto so abien no bɛtumi de fayil yi de kɔmputa mu, de n'asɛmti a ɛto so abiɛsa yi de kɔmputa mu, de n'asɛmti a ɛto so abiɛsa yi de kɔmputa mu, de n'asɛmti a ɛto so abiɛsa yi de kɔmputa mu, ne de n'asɛmti a ɛto so abiɛsa yi de kɔmputa mu. Follow first-start guidance and Activity & Diagnostics instead of treating the saved dashboard entry as a installed game.
Agorɔ bi hia nhyehyɛɛ, nokorɛdie, anaa agodie mu kyɛfa/asae nhyehyɛe ansa na obi betumi de ne ho akɔka agodie no ho. Wie saa ɔfã no wɔ beae a agodie no hwehwɛ.
compatibility verification, compatibility verification Asɛm a w'ayi no adi, asɛm a w'ayi no adi, asɛm a w'ayi no adi, ne sɛnea w'ahwehwɛ adwuma a Synix rehwɛ no ho nsɛm. Asɛmfua a ɛnyɛ sɛ wɔhwɛ no so kyerɛ sɛ nkyerɛkyerɛmu biara nni hɔ. Eyi nkyerɛ sɛ agodie no agye din sɛ asɛe.
Ready nsunsuansoɔ anaa beaeɛ mu nhwehwɛmu a ɛyɛ yie nkyerɛ sɛ wo nsa bɛka intanɛt, mods pa, anaa sɛ w'atumi ne obi biara adi nkitaho. Di awieɛ bere a woasɔ ɔfã ne wiase no ahwɛ.

data.name: Content.D04B8B2F340C3B82596E
data.value:
Nhyehyɛe a wɔpaw no ma ɛhwɛ nkrataa no so wɔ nkrataa a ɛwɔ saa nkrataa no mu. Hwɛ baabi a agodie no gye wiase no di ankasa ansa na wode wo ho ato so.
MA W'ADWENE Nkyene 1. Ma server no nkɔ Synix mu na twɛn sɛ n'akwantu no befi hɔ. 2. Paw backup dwumadie no wɔ Server Options mu. 3. Hwehwɛ baabi a woakɔ, baabi a wobɛkɔ, sɛnea wɔaka ho asɛm, ne disk mu baabi a wowɔ. 4. Hu na twɛn awie. 5. Paw Open Backup Folder de hwehwɛ nhyehyeɛ. Fa ne nokwaredi nkrataa no ka ho.
ASƐM A ƐDA SO Nsakrae no mu na ɛwɔ fahodie a wɔde si hɔ no, ɛnyɛ subfolder ketewa bi a wɔde sie nko. Nneɛma akɛse a wɔde di agorɔ no betumi ahwehwɛ bere ne adansibea pii.
Agye wɔ AppData mu, Nhoma, drive foforo, anaa kɔmputa afiri a wɔde di dwuma wɔ agodie no mu betumi ato saa adaka no akyi. Fa ɔkwan a wɔde di dwuma wɔ agodie no mu no so boa saa nneɛma no ma ɛyɛ soronko.
ASƐM A ƐDA SO NE ASƐM A ƐDA SO Adwumayɛfoɔ backup root no yɛ C:\Synix\BackupGames. Settings → Backups a ɛma wopaw root foforɔ na wode backup limit a wɔde sie no to hɔ.
Ɛwɔ sɛ ɛkwan a wɔfa so kɔ hɔ no wɔ baabi a ɛbɛn baabi a ɛrekɔ no. Sɛ wosesa backup root a, ɛnkeka nnwumakuo a ɛwɔ hɔ no anaa wompɛ sɛ wotwa; Hwehwɛ baabi dedaw no mu hwehwɛ backup dedaw no.
Adwinnadeɛ no twe nnwinnadeɛ a atwam no firi hɔ bere a wɔboro hyeɛ a wɔahyehyɛ no mu wɔ backup adansi ho. Kɔ so hwɛ nneɛma a wobesiesie no daa wɔ baabi a wɔasiesie ho no akyi.
Fa wiase a ɛho hia foforo a woadi ho adanse no sie wɔ baabi foforo. Disk a ɛmfata no betumi asɛe nkatabo ne backup a ɛwɔ disk koro no ara so no nyinaa. ZIP a ɛwɔ external deployment folder mu nyɛ automatically a edi mũ VM anaa database backup.

data.name: Content.D2EE952679F0F36E81E6
data.value:
Kenkan Windows nkra no pɛpɛɛpɛ ansa na woasusuw nea ɛsɛ sɛ wosesa ho. Nhyehyɛe bi a wɔasiw so, file-access mfomso, ne game runtime a ɛfi hɔ no yɛ ɔhaw horow.
SYNIX rensi hɔ na ɛrensi hɔ Fa krataa a wɔato din anaa asɛm no di dwuma WinGet nkrataa a wobesusuw ho.Synix. Sɛ wode faenu no siesie a, ɛkyerɛ sɛ wonnya kwan nkɔ hɔ a, to Synix nhwɛsoɔ no na fa saa kwan no di dwuma yiye na bɔ mmɔden bio. Hwehwɛ nkrataa no mu nkɔmmɔbɔ ne ahobammɔ software nkrataa mu sɛ ɔhaw no bɛkɔ so a.
Mma wompɛ sɛ woyi server data no fi hɔ anaa fa bɔ ho ban sɛ gyinapɛn a wɔde siesie ade.
SMARTSCREEN Nyamesom ho kɔkɔbɔ betumi ama woanya nsɛm pii → Atena so ɔkwan biara so, a egyina Windows mmara no so. Nhwɛso yi a ɛwɔ hɔ no nyɛ adanse a ɛkyerɛ sɛ adansedi wɔ hɔ. Hwehwɛ beae a wɔhyehyɛ no ho nsɛm mu na hwehwɛ kɔkɔbɔ no mu ansa na woasi gyinae sɛ wobɛkɔ so anaa.
SMART APP CONTROL Eyi betumi asiw app bi kwan bere a Windows ntumi nyi ahotoso a ɛfata. Ɛmfa ho saa no, ɛnni app bi a wɔde toto SmartScreen's Run ho. Mfa Windows ahobammɔ dwumadie nkyɛ Synix di dwuma nko.
ANTIVIRUS OR HASH FAIL Hwehwɛ baabi a wobehu ne adansedi no mu pɛpɛɛpɛ. Mfa no sɛ kɔkɔbɔ bi yɛ false positive ɛfiri sɛ wɔde din Synix ato ɔfã no so. SHA-256 hash a ɛne bɔ hyia no da faeloo no adi; ɛnhyehyɛ gyinapɛn anaa nkyerɛwde a wɔde to nsa.
Kyerɛ kɔkɔbɔ ne ɔkwan pɔtee a wɔfa so siesie no ho amanneɛbɔ, na fa nsɛm a ɛfa wo ho no to nkyɛn. Kɔ so twe wo ho fi nneɛma a ɛho ntew ho anaa fa wo ho fi hash verification ho.

data.name: Content.DEF7504305FCA62C7644
data.value:
Fa Settings → Backups di dwuma wɔ Synix fafa/fa no kɔ akyiri. Eyi yɛ soronko wɔ sɛ wobɛtwerɛ nkatabo bi a ɛwɔ hɔ no ho.
Hwehwɛ nea ɛsɛ sɛ ɛtu Nnwomasua nketewa a wɔde di dwuma titiriw C:\Synix dua. Adwumayɛfoɔ anaa adesoa nkrataa a ɛwɔ akyi ne apɔwmuden agyinatuo no hia dwuma a ɛyɛ soronko. Kyerɛw wɔn kwan ansa na wɔrefi ase. Windows ahoɔfɛdeɛ betumi nso ahi sɛ wɔsan susuw ho wɔ baabi a wɔrekɔ.
EXPORT 1. Gyae adwumayɛfoɔ no na wie dwuma a wɔde siesie, twe, ne backup. 2. Paw encrypted anaa normal export. 3. Paw baabi a wobɛkɔ wɔ baabi a wompɛ baabi a wobɛkɔ no, na hwɛ baabi a wobɛkɔ ne baabi a wobɛkɔ. 4. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wotumi de nnoɔma a wɔakyekyere wɔn ho no di dwuma a, paw kratafa a emu yɛ den na fa sie soronko. 5. Twɛn ma .synixbackup nkrataa no awie, na hwɛ sɛ ɛyɛ nokware.
HWƐ ASƐM a Ɛfata Apɔnkɔ a wɔakyekyere no bɔ nkrataa no ho ban na ɛboa ma wɔde adansedie a wɔaboa wɔn ma wɔde kɔ baabi a wɔrekɔ akɔto Windows twerɛtohɔbea.
Wɔamfa nsonsonoe biara amfa nsonsonoe biara antom. Agodie nsɛmma nhoma ne nnwinnade a ɛwɔ mu no betumi ada ahintasɛm adi. Sɛ wofa Windows-kyekyere nsaano nkyerɛmu a, ɛnkyerɛ sɛ wobetumi de adi dwuma wɔ akontaa foforo bi mu.
ASƐM A ƐDA SO 1. Di kan nya baabi a wokɔ no ho nsɛm a ɛwɔ Synix. 2. Si import/verification controls no na paw nkrataa a wopɛ. 3. Sɛ wobisa a, fa wo nsa ka asetsena no na hwɛ sɛ w'ahyehyɛde no yɛ yie. 4. Hwehwɛ baabi a wokɔ, disk ho ahiade, na kyerɛw kɔkɔbɔ ahorow no so. 5. Ma wɔmmfa ntoasoɔ, nhwehwɛmu, ne adesoa awie. 6. Hwehwɛ ɔsomfoɔ kwan, pon, mmere, backup beaeɛ, ne nhunumu ansa na woahyɛ biribi ase.
Fa Satisfactory di dwuma foforɔ, sɛ wo din a ɛwɔ hɔ anaa wɔn nsɛm a wɔabɔ ho ban no ntumi nhyia bio. Fa krataafa a edi kan ne data dedaw no sie kɔsi sɛ wobɛsesa aguadifo a wɔde aba no.
Data migrations a wɔboa ma wɔn a w'ani gye ho no hwɛ data database copy ansa na w'ani agye ho. Sɛ import anaa migyire no to apue a, fa saa copy no ne asesae asɛm no sie sen sɛ wobesi dwuma a ɛwɔ database no ananmu bere a Synix reyɛ adwuma no.

data.name: Content.E03D856AEDD6B1B81DFD
data.value:
Fa & Launch a wɔapaw no ka ho ne ne de a wɔboa no fa no ho. Kɔ so di ahyɛde a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran no so gye sɛ wote asɛm no ase yiye.
ASƐM A ƐDA SO Fa Advanced mode di dwuma bere a wohia raw nhyia. Hwehwɛ nsɛnkyerɛne, akwan a wobɛtumi afa so, ne nhyehyeɛ a wɔhwehwɛ wɔ agodie no mu din. Synix de adansedie adansedie adi dwuma dedaw; sɛ wode krataa foforo ka ho a, ebetumi ama nneɛma asesa.
Nkyerɛkyerɛmu ntwerɛmu anaa nnkyerɛmu ntwerɛmu ntwerɛmu ntwerɛmu ntwerɛmu ntwerɛmu ntwerɛmu ntwerɛmu ntwerɛmu. Mma wo mfa din a wode bɛkyerɛ wɔ ahyɛde bi mu da sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɛbɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wobɛtumi akyerɛw so.
EXPORTED LAUNCH FILES Wɔ adwendwene ho profile ho no, Server Options → Create Batch File kyerɛw tumi krataa a wɔasiesie de adi dwuma no kɔ script bi mu.
Saa file no betumi ayɛ kratafa a wobetumi akenkan anaa ɔsom adwuma ho nsɛnkyerɛne na ama atumi adi dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛmfata so. Kɔ so yɛ no kokoam na hwɛ ansa na woahyɛ mu anaa woayi adi.
Sɛ wode script no di dwuma wɔ Synix akyi a, ɛremma Synix dwumadie nyinaa, ahwɛfoɔ kuo ho nhyehyɛe, backup, anaa nhyehyɛe mu nsiesie. Mfa nnyɛ adwuma bere a Synix anya saa adwumadie no adi dwuma dedaw.
ASƐM A ƐDA SO NSƐM A ƐDA SO Nnwumakuo bi de wɔn ankasa dwumadi nnwinnade di dwuma wɔ agodie mu, na ɛnnyɛ adwuma a ɛrekɔ so wɔ kɔmputa ntoasoɔ biara mu. Saa nnwinnadeɛ no bɛtumi ahiɔ sɛ wobɛtumi de nhyiamu a ɛho hia soronko adi dwuma, na ɛbɛtumi ayɛ sɛ wɔremmfa nhyiamu no nni dwuma. Di wo profile no ho akwankyerɛ akyi sen sɛ wobɛyɛ biribi foforo a wɔde di dwuma anaa woboa.

data.name: Content.EA307763F93AA4306555
data.value:
Fa krataafa a wɔde bɛma wo no di dwuma. Ɛfa .NET runtime a Synix hia no ka ho; game servers bɛtumi akɔ so anya wɔn ankasa ahiadeɛ.
HWƐ ASƐM A WƆSƐ SƐ WOHYƐ • MSI: Twe SynixSetup.msi, di dwuma, na bue Synix Control Panel fi Start menu mu. Deɛ edidisoɔ a wɔde di dwuma no yɛ %LocalAppData%\Programs\Synix. • WinGet: Use the exact package ubidzz.Synix. WinGet Ɔhyehyɛ ne Nhyehyɛe ho asɛm no fa akwankyerɛ ahorow no ho. • Agyede a wɔde yɛ adwuma: Fa mmara kwan so a wɔde yɛ adwuma no hyɛ adaka bi mu na fa di dwuma wɔ hɔ. Sɛ wode saa dwumadibea no yɛ adwuma a, ɛnkyerɛ sɛ wo de w'asɔretiafoɔ no bɛsan ayɛ adwuma koraa.
Nkrataa a wɔato din: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/releases/latest
ASƐM A ƐDA SO NSƐM A ƐDA SO 1. Kɔ so twe nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ no, kɔyɛ backup, na yɛhwɛ so yiye. 2. Ma wo game servers no nkɔ Synix mu na fa Synix to hɔ sɛnea ɛteɛ. 3. Fa updater anaa installer no di dwuma wɔ w'asɔde a woapaw no ho. 4. Bue Synix bio na hwɛ sɛ w'akoa ne w'akwan no yɛ papa anaa.
Sɛ wode EXE-gyina so dwumadie a atwam no si hɔ ma MSI no a, di kan yi application dedaw no fi hɔ. Kɔ so hwɛ ne nkuraho nsɛm ne nkuraho nkuraho nkuraho nkuraho. Mma wo mmfa C:\Synix mmpa program no so.
Nhyehyɛe foforo biara a wobɛtumi de adi dwuma no rensi agorɔ ahorow a woayɛ ho dwuma no so dua. Fa server a wɔapaw no no Update dwumadi no di dwuma ma saa.
Sɛ Windows bɔ amanneɛ sɛ wɔanka kwan a wɔde di dwuma no wɔ bere a wɔreyɛ adwuma no a, hwɛ sɛ copy a wɔreyɛ adwuma no nni hɔ bio. Mma wompɛ sɛ wokyerɛw dwumadi bi a ɛretwa so anaa yi server data fi hɔ na ama woatumi adi mfomso no ho dwuma.

data.value:
Synix di nhyehyeɛ nhyɛso ho dwuma ansa na wɔde hyɛ agyinatuo bi mu sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɛrenyɛ den sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ host no so. Sɛ wɔtwentwɛn wo nan ase anaa wɔakyekyere wo ho a, kenkan adansedi asɛm no.
HWƐ ƆWƐN A WƆKYERƐ Ma adwinnadeɛ a ɛfa Windows ne akyi dwumadie ne agodie no ho kwan. Ma disk mu baabi a wobɛtumi ahu nsɛm foforo, nkrataa a ɛtra hɔ bere tiaa bi, nneɛma a wode bɛkora so, ne nneɛma a wode bɛyɛ backup.
Minecraft nkaeɛ hyeɛ a wɔahyehyɛ no nya ne di dwuma/nkurɔ berɛ so nkɛntɛnso. Ɛnyɛ nhyehyɛe biara a wɔde di dwuma wɔ agodie biara mu no ho na ɛwɔ wiase nyinaa.
Ahyehyɛde ho nhwehwɛmu nnyi sɛ server bi bɛkɔ CPU/RAM adaka mu anaa ɛnsɛ sɛ Windows ntumi nwie ahyehyɛde da. Fa nnwinnade monitor ne PC dashboard nyinaa mfitiaseɛ no yɛ adwuma na woate adesoa ankasa no ase.
Intanɛt so ahwɛfoɔ Nkontaabu a wɔde yɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ network-warning ho no hwɛ bandwidth/resource tebea ahorow a ɛnsa da, na ɛka SteamCMD dwumadie a wonim no ho nsɛm de tew kɔkɔbɔ bɔne so.
Ɛnyɛ firewall, traffic filter, anaa DDoS ho banbɔ adwuma. Ɔbɔ kɔkɔ no nkyerɛ obi a ɔtow hyɛɛ ne so anaa adanseɛ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔtow hyɛɛ ne so.
Sɛ wɔabɔ wo kɔkɔ a, fa adwuma a woreyɛ no toto nneɛma a wonim sɛ wode ayɛ download, backup, ne dwumadi afoforo ho. Hwehwɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa ho ansa na woasesa ahobammɔ anaa intanɛt dwumadibea nkataho.

data.name: Content.F797B7FAAA8293240799
data.value:
ASƐM A ƐDA SO:
1. Yi 'server-settings.json' siesie na wode wo Factorio adwumayɛbea no ho nimdeɛ ne wo user token bɛhyɛ hɔ ama amansan mmere a wɔde di dwuma.
2. Nkrataa ahodoɔ a etwa sɛ yɛhyehyɛ wɔ kasa ahodoɔ mu https://wiki.factorio.com/Multiplayer#Server_settings

data.name: Content.F83D1D2838B71617191E
data.value:
Paw Rust profile no na hwɛ wiase, identity, gameplay, query, ne companion asetena ansa na worefi ase.
SERVER IDENTITY Synix de +server.identity dwumadie a ɛboaa no firi server no din mu. Kɔ so hwɛ faako a wɔde siesie nneɛma ne ahyɛnsode a wɔde siesie nneɛma no so sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔrenyɛ wiase anaa nhyehyɛe bi a wɔmpɛ.
RUST+ Fa app port soronko a wɔaboa ma ne ho adwuma no, na di Rust's pairing ne network requirements akyi. N'awieeɛ gyinabea no yɛ soronko wɔ player gameplay ne opsional RCON administration ho.
Hwɛ port a wɔasiesie no ankasa sen sɛ wobɛtwetwe mmara bi afi Rust adwumayɛni foforo so. Bɔ RCON adansedi ho ban na mma wonhyɛ no adi mfa mmoa nkurɔfo sɛ wɔnkɔ.
VANILLA NE OXIDE Vanilla de dwumadibea no nsɛmma nhoma no di dwuma. Sɛ wɔpaw Oxide a, wɔde official framework a wɔaboa ano no to Steam files no akyi. Nhyehyɛe no nhyiamu nkyerɛ plugins biara.
Fa Mod & Plugin Manager mmoa local workflow no di dwuma wɔ Oxide/uMod dwumadi a wobehu ho. Plugins da so ara hia nkyerɛase a edi mũ ne mmeae a wɔde wɔn ho to so.
Synix de oxide runtime a wɔaboa ano no di dwuma foforɔ wɔ Rust nkwankyerɛ anaa ne nhyehyɛeɛ akyi bere a wɔapaw saa nhyehyɛeɛ no. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wosan kɔ Vanilla nkrataa a ɛwɔ hɔ no so a, sesa nhyehyɛe gyinabea no na yɛ Update anaa Validate workflow a wɔaboa no.
Ansa na wobesesa nhyehyeɛ anaa agodie no, sie wiase, nhyehyeɛ, ne plugin data. Kɔhwɛ agyinatuo ne Oxide logs no nyinaa akyi; nhyehyɛeɛ a edi mu a wɔde di dwuma no nnyɛ adanse sɛ Plugin biara adi dwuma pɛpɛɛpɛ.

data.name: Content.FE08796B9B27C2F7036C
data.value: ATLAS ne clustered server na obetumi aka saa fayilo yi ma ɛfiri sɛ wobekum no. Fa Grapeshot Games ServerGridEditor a ɛto so abiɛsa no ma wonya nea wubetumi biara. Copy ServerGrid.json and ServerGrid.ServerOnly.json into the server's ShooterGame folder. Nea ɛto so anan ATLAS, kɔ AtlasTools\RedisDatabase\redis-server_start.bat na fa Redis kɔ. Wobenya Redis bound to 127.0.0.1; do not expose port 6379 to the LAN, router, or Internet. Official editor: https://github.com/GrapeshotGames/ServerGridEditor
